title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
english: A Massachusetts judge has declared a mistrial in the case of Lindsay Clancy after the jury could not reach a unanimous verdict regarding the murder of her three young children. Although Clancy admits to the killings, her defense team argues she was experiencing postpartum psychosis at the time and should not be held legally responsible. The 36-year-old former nurse will remain in a mental health facility while prosecutors determine whether to pursue a new trial or reach a settlement.
amharic: ሊንዚ ክላንሲ ሶስት ትናንሽ ልጆቿን በመግደሏ የቀረበባት ክስ ዳኞች በአንድነት መወሰን ባለመቻላቸው ዳኛው ክሱ እንዲቋረጥ ወስነዋል። ተከሳሡ ልጆቹን እንደገደለች ብታምንም፣ ጠበቆቿ በወቅቱ ከወሊድ በኋላ የሚከሰት የአእምሮ ህመም (postpartum psychosis) እንደነበረባት በመግለጽ ወንጀለኛ አይደለችም በማለት ይከራከራሉ። የ36 ዓመቷ የቀድሞ ነርስ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአእምሮ ህክምና ማዕከል ውስጥ የምትገኝ ሲሆን፣ አቃቤ ህግ እንደገና ክስ መመስረት ወይም በስምምነት መፍታት እንዳለበት ቀጣይ ስብሰባ ይወስናል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa tokko mootummaa Massachusetts keessatti, Lindsay Clancy ijoollee ishii sadii ajjeesuun himatamtee turte irratti, gumii murtee kennu dadhabee tures dhimmi kun akka dhaabbatu murteessaniiru. Clancy ijoollee ishii ajjeesuu ishii kan amantus, abukaattoonni ishii yeroo sana rakkoo sammuu da'umsa booda dhufuun miidhamtee waan turteef itti gaafatamtuu miti jedhanii falmatu. Ganna 36 kan taate kun ammas bakka yaala sammuutti kan argamtu yoo ta'u, abbaan alangaa irra deebii murtii kennuu ykn mariidhaan furachuu isaanii gabaasa gara fuulduraatiin kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
english: Germany is facing a significant political shift as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party aims to win a regional election in Saxony-Anhalt. If successful, this would be the first time a far-right group holds state-level power in Germany since the post-war era. Supporters are drawn to the party due to frustrations over immigration, the economy, and the perceived failures of mainstream political leadership.
amharic: ጀርመን በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት ግዛት በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ታያለች ተብሎ ይጠበቃል፣ ይህም የቀኝ ዘመም አራማጁ የአማራጭ ለጀርመን (AfD) ፓርቲ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በክልል ደረጃ ስልጣን ለመያዝ እየተንቀሳቀሰ ነው። ይህ ፓርቲ ድል ከተቀዳጀ፣ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ በጀርመን የክልል ስልጣን የያዘ የመጀመሪያው የቀኝ ዘመም ፓርቲ ይሆናል። የፓርቲው ደጋፊዎች በኢሚግሬሽን፣ በኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች እና በነባር ፓርቲዎች መበሳጨታቸው ለዚህ ድጋፍ ዋነኛ ምክንያቶች ተደርገው ይወሰዳሉ።
oromo: Jarmanin filannoo naannoo Saxony-Anhalt irratti jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa kan qunnamtu ta'uun ishee dubbatamaa jira; kunis paartiin mirga-qaxxaamuraa Alternative for Germany (AfD) jedhamu sadarkaa naannootti aangoo argachuuf carraaqaa waan jiruufi. Yoo paartiin kun injifate, erga waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda paartiin mirga-qaxxaamuraa tokko naannoo tokko bulchuun seenaa keessatti kan jalqabaati. Deeggartoonni paartichaa rakkoolee godaantotaa, diinagdee fi dadhabina paartilee siyaasaa durii mudateen kan irraan kan ka'e jijjiirama barbaadaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US may target Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain ‘very soon’
english: US President Donald Trump has reiterated his threat to potentially strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain in the near future. In response, Iran's air defense leadership stated that the nation remains fully prepared to handle any military confrontation. Officials in Tehran emphasized that they view these ongoing threats as serious and remain vigilant.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ የኢራኑን 'ፒካክስ' ተራራ ኢላማ ሊያደርጉ እንደሚችሉ እንደገና ዝተዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ የኢራን የአየር መከላከያ አዛዥ ሀገሪቱ ለማንኛውም ወታደራዊ ግጭት ዝግጁ እንደሆነች ገልጸዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ስጋቱ አሁንም ስላለ ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp gargaarsa ykn weerara gaara 'Pikkaaks' kan Iraan irratti gaggeessuuf sodaachisuu isaanii irra deebhanii dubbataniiru. Iraan gama isheetiin, ajajaan ittisa qilleensaa biyyattii akka ibsanitti, isaan weerara kamiyyuu akkaataa barbaachiseef qophii akka ta'an ibsaniiru. Hoji geggeessitoonni Iraan balaan ammayyuu waan hin dabarreef qophiin isaanii itti fufuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: ‘Small potatoes’: US President Trump downplays war on Iran
english: President Donald Trump has described the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran as a minor military issue, dismissing its significance despite the loss of 18 American service members and rising energy costs. Both Trump and Vice President JD Vance have strategically avoided labeling the situation as a formal war, instead characterizing it as intermittent strikes to bypass the need for congressional approval. Analysts suggest this specific language is part of an administration effort to minimize public concern and avoid constitutional requirements regarding war declarations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን የአሜሪካ እና የእስራኤል ግጭት ምንም ያህል የ18 የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ህይወት ቢቀጠፍና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ቢጨምርም እንደ ቀላል ጉዳይ ገልጸውታል። ትራምፕ እና ምክትላቸው ጄዲ ቫንስ ግጭቱን በይፋ ጦርነት ብለው ከመጥራት ይልቅ የሕግ አውጭውን አካል ፈቃድ ላለመጠየቅ ሲባል እንደ የተወሰኑ ጥቃቶች አድርገው ለማቅረብ እየሞከሩ ነው። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ከሆነ ይህ አገላለጽ አስተዳደሩ የህዝብን ትኩረት ለመቀነስ እና ከጦርነት አዋጅ ጋር የተያያዙ ሕገ-መንግስታዊ ግዴታዎችን ለማምለጥ የሚጠቀምበት ስልት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp, waraanni Ameerikaa fi Israa’el garaa garaa Iran irratti gaggeessaa jiran kun lubbuun loltoota Ameerikaa 18 darbee fi gatiin boba'aa dabalee osoo jiruu, akka waan salphaatti ilaaluun dubbataniiru. Traampis ta'e itti-aanaan isaanii Jeedi Vaans, rakkoo kana 'waraana' jedhanii waamuun irraa of qusachuun, hayyama paarlaamaa fudhachuu irraa bilisa bahuuf jecha 'duula xiqqoo' jedhanii gadi qabanii ibsaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, jecha akkanaa fayyadamuun isaanii mootummaan kun guddina rakkoo kanaa dhoksuuf fi seera bu'uuraa waraana labsuu wajjin walqabatu jalaa miliiquuf mala fayyadamaa jiranu dha.

title: Tunisia arrests journalist Mohamed Yousfi amid crackdown on critics
english: Tunisian authorities have arrested prominent journalist and editor Mohamed Yousfi, marking the latest move in a ongoing government campaign against media figures and political critics. This detention follows several recent convictions and prison sentences handed down to other journalists and activists under the administration of President Kais Saied. Human rights organizations are expressing deep concern, arguing that these actions reflect a broader effort to suppress independent voices and undermine the nation's judicial independence.
amharic: የቱኒዚያ ባለስልጣናት ታዋቂውን ጋዜጠኛ መሐመድ ዩሱፍን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉት ሲሆን ይህም በፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሳይድ አስተዳደር ስር በሚዲያ ባለሙያዎች እና በተቺዎች ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው የዘመቻ አካል ነው። ይህ እስር በሌሎች ጋዜጠኞች እና አክቲቪስቶች ላይ በተላለፉ ተከታታይ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔዎች የተከተለ ነው። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ነጻ አስተያየቶችን ለማፈን እና የፍትህ ስርአቱን ነጻነት ለመሸርሸር የሚደረግ ጥረት መሆኑን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Tunisiyaa gabaasaa fi qophiin beekamaa Mohaamed Yuusfii hidhuun, mootummaan pirezidaant Kaayiis Saayid mormitootaa fi miidiyaaleerratti tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiru kan itti fufsiise ta’u agarsiisa. Hidhaan kun, kanaan dura gabaasotii fi qabsaa’ota biroo irratti murtiiwwan adabbii darbaa turan kan hordofee dha. Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa tarkaanfiiwwan kun sagalee bilisaa ukkaamsuu fi walaba ta’uu sirna seeraa biyyattii miidhuuf kan karoorfaman ta’uu ibsuun mormaa jiru.

title: Mock Republican convention website tops Google, redirects to Epstein files
english: A fake website pretending to be the official page for the 2026 Republican convention appeared at the top of Google search results. Instead of providing event details, the site redirected visitors to government documents regarding Jeffrey Epstein. Republican officials have condemned the prank as misinformation, while Democratic politicians are using the incident to highlight ongoing controversies surrounding the Trump administration's handling of the Epstein files.
amharic: ለ2026 የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ጉባኤ ኦፊሴላዊ ድረ-ገጽ መስሎ የቀረበ የሀሰት ድረ-ገጽ በጎግል የፍለጋ ውጤቶች ላይ ቀዳሚ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። ድረ-ገጹ ስለ ዝግጅቱ መረጃ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ተጠቃሚዎችን ወደ ጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን መዝገቦች ቀጥተኛ አገናኝ ይወስዳል። የሪፐብሊካን ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱን ሀሰተኛ መረጃ ሲሉ ሲያወግዙት፣ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ አባላት ግን ይህንን አጋጣሚ በመጠቀም የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከኤፕስታይን መዝገቦች ጋር በተያያዘ የፈጠረውን ውዝግብ እያነሱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Websayitiin sobaa kan walgahii paartii Rippabilikaanii bara 2026 fakkaatee dhihaate, bu'aa barbaaddee Google irratti sadarkaa duraa qabate ture. Websayitichi odeeffannoo walgahichaa kennuu mannaa, namoota fayyadaman gara galmee seenaa Jeefrii Episteeyinitti geessaa ture. Hoggantoonni Rippabilikaanii gocha kana 'oduu sobaa' jechuun balaaleffatan, gama biraatiin ammoo miseensonni Paartii Dimokiraataas haala bulchiinsi Traamp galmee Episteeyin qabate irratti guungummii uumame kaasuuf carraa kana itti fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Tunisia police arrest journalist Mohamed Yousfi, critic of Kais Saied
english: Tunisian police have detained journalist Mohamed Yousfi, a well-known critic of President Kais Saied, while he was arriving for a radio interview. While authorities have not officially stated the reason for his arrest, rights groups view this as part of an ongoing trend to suppress independent journalism in the country. Several other media professionals have also faced legal action or imprisonment since the President began ruling by decree in 2021.
amharic: የቱኒዚያ ፖሊስ ለፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድ ጠንካራ ተቺ የሆኑትን ጋዜጠኛ መሐመድ ዩሱፍን በሬዲዮ ፕሮግራም ላይ ለመሳተፍ ሲሄዱ በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ለእስሩ ግልጽ ምክንያት ባይሰጡም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች ይህ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ነጻ ጋዜጠኝነትን ለማፈን የሚደረግ ጥረት አካል እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ከ2021 ጀምሮ በአዋጅ መግዛት ከጀመሩ ወዲህ በርካታ ጋዜጠኞች እና የሚዲያ ባለሙያዎች ተመሳሳይ እስራትና ክስ እንደተፈረደባቸው ይታወቃል።
oromo: Poolisiin Tunisiyaa gaazexeessaa fi qeeqa cimaa pireezidaant Kaayis Saayid ta'an Mohaammad Yuusif, sagantaa raadiyoorratti hirmaachuuf yommuu deeman qabanii hidhaniiru. Mootummaan sababa hidhaa kanaa ifatti kan hin ibsin yoo ta'u, gareewwan mirga namoomaa gochi kun miidiyaa walaba ta'e biyyattii keessaa cunqursuuf kan godhamaa jiruudha jedhaniiru. Pireezidaantichi bara 2021 irraa eegalanii aangoo guutuu qabatanii erga bulchuu eegalanii booda, gaazexeessitoonni fi ogeeyyiin miidiyaa hedduun hidhaa fi himannaa adda addaa keessa turaniiru.

title: Kpler says Hormuz traffic dropped sharply on 31 August, Bab el-Mandeb stable
english: Maritime data firm Kpler reported that ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped by 50% on August 31, with only five confirmed crossings compared to ten the previous day. In contrast, activity in the Bab el-Mandeb remained steady, with 35 vessels passing through the area without any reported incidents. Officials noted that the Hormuz data is still preliminary and may be updated as more information about unrecorded vessels becomes available.
amharic: የባህር ትራንስፖርት መረጃ ኩባንያ ክፕለር (Kpler) እንዳስታወቀው ኦገስት 31 ቀን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ቁጥር በ50 በመቶ ቀንሷል። ቀደም ሲል አስር መርከቦች ያልፉበት በነበረው መስመር በዚያ ዕለት የተመዘገቡት አምስት መርከቦች ብቻ ናቸው። በሌላ በኩል በባብ ኤል-ማንዴብ በኩል ያለው እንቅስቃሴ የተረጋጋ ሆኖ የቀጠለ ሲሆን 35 መርከቦች ያለምንም ችግር አልፈዋል። የሆርሙዝ መረጃ ጊዜያዊ መሆኑን እና ወደፊት ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች ሲገኙ ቁጥሩ ሊቀየር እንደሚችል ኩባንያው ገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni odeeffannoo bishaanii Kpler akka gabaaseetti, lakkoofsi markaa qaxxaamura Hormuz gidduu galeessa gaafa Hagayya 31 irraa kaasee dhibbeentaa 50n hir'ateera. Guyyaa sana markawwan shan qofatu qaxxaamure; kunis guyyaa durii irraa yoo ilaalamu hir'ina guddaadha. Gama biraatiin, sochii Bab el-Mandeb irratti ta'e tasgabbaa’aa kan ture yoo ta'u, markawwan 35 rakkoo tokko malee qaxxaamuraniiru. Odeeffannoon Hormuz kun ammaaf kan jalqabaa waan ta'eef, odeeffannoon dabalataa yoo argame lakkoofsi isaa jijjiiramuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: US okays $5.75 billion munitions, engines sale to Saudi Arabia
english: The United States government has authorized a major $5.75 billion arms deal with Saudi Arabia, including precision-guided munitions from Boeing and advanced engines from Honeywell. This agreement aims to bolster the kingdom's defensive capabilities against regional threats while deepening military cooperation with American forces. Officials stated that the sale supports national security interests by strengthening the defense of a key regional partner.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከሳውዲ አረቢያ ጋር የ5.75 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የጦር መሳሪያ ሽያጭ ስምምነት አጽድቋል። ስምምነቱ ቦይንግ የሚያመርታቸውን ዘመናዊ ሚሳኤሎች እና የሃኒዌል የሞተር መለዋወጫዎችን ያካተተ ነው። ይህ ግዢ የሳውዲን የመከላከል አቅም በማጠናከር ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላትን ወታደራዊ ትብብር እንደሚያሳድግ ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Sa'udii Arabiyaatti meeshaalee waraanaa fi injiniiwwan gurguruuf waliigaltee doolaara biliyoona 5.75 ta'u raggaasiseera. Waliigalteen kun meeshaalee gurguddaa Booyingii fi injiniiwwan Haniwell kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaa humna ittisa biyyaalessaa Sa'udii cimsuufi. Mootummaan Ameerikaa akka jedhetti, gurgurtaan kun nageenya naannichaa eeguufi tumsa waraanaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru caalaatti cimsachuuf gargaara.

title: Iran vows ‘pre-emptive operations’ against perceived threats
english: A senior Iranian military official announced that the country is shifting its defense strategy to include pre-emptive strikes against any potential threats. Brigadier-General Mohammad Akrami Nia explained that these measures are intended to deter enemies by acting before they can strike. This change in military doctrine signals a more aggressive approach to national security.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን ሀገሪቱ በየትኛውም ስጋት ላይ ቅድመ ጥቃት የሚሰነዝር አዲስ የመከላከያ ስትራቴጂ መከተሏን አስታውቀዋል። ብርጋዴር ጀነራል መሀመድ አክራሚ ኒያ እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ እርምጃ ጠላቶችን ለመከላከል እና ጥቃት ከመሰንዘራቸው በፊት ለመመከት ያለመ ነው። ይህ ወታደራዊ አቋም ለሀገራዊ ደህንነት የበለጠ ጠንካራ አቀራረብን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan akka jedhanitti, biyyattiin miidhaa kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf tarkaanfii duraa fudhachuuf karoora qabdi. Birgaadiyar Jeneraal Mohaammad Akraamii Niyaa akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni kun diinonni utuu hin haleelin dura of ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha. Jijjiiramni tooftaa waraanaa kunis eegumsa biyyattii irratti fedhii cimaa akka qaban agarsiisa.

title: Israeli police kill Palestinian in Jerusalem as army blocks aid for Qusra
english: Israeli police shot and killed a 33-year-old Palestinian man in Jerusalem after alleging he attempted a stabbing attack. Simultaneously, the Israeli military blocked a group of activists from delivering essential food and medical supplies to a Palestinian village that has been under siege by settlers for nearly a month. These events occurred alongside a broader wave of military raids and settler attacks across the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፖሊስ በኢየሩሳሌም የ33 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ወጣት ቢላዋ ሊያጠቃ ሞክሯል በሚል ተኩሶ ገድሎታል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች ለወራት ታግዶ በቆየው የፍልስጤም መንደር ውስጥ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ምግብ እና መድሃኒቶችን ለማድረስ የሞከሩ አክቲቪስቶችን ከልክለዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ ከተካሄዱ ተከታታይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎች እና የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ጋር በተያያዘ የተከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Poolisiin Israa'el nama Falasxiimii umrii 33 ta'e tokko magaalaa Yerusaalemitti waraansa hidhatee dhufeera jechuun dhukaasaa ajjeesaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, waraanni Israa'el ganda Falasxiimii kan ji'a tokko guutuu jiraattotni ishee qe'ee isaanii keessatti cufamanii turanitti gargaarsa nyaataa fi qorichaa geessuuf kan yaalan namoota nagaa akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Gochootni kun, naannoo Qilleensa dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara waraanaa fi haleellaa godaantotaan raawwatamaa jiru waliin wal qabatu.

title: Costa Rican president signals openness to domestic US military operations
english: Costa Rican President Laura Fernandez has expressed interest in collaborating with the United States military to combat transnational crime, drug trafficking, and terrorism. She clarified that no specific plans are currently underway and stressed that any foreign military involvement would require formal approval from the national legislature. This stance reflects her commitment to addressing the country's rising homicide rates without resorting to the long-term states of emergency used by other regional leaders.
amharic: የኮስታ ሪካዋ ፕሬዚዳንት ላውራ ፈርናንዴዝ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የድንበር ተሻጋሪ ወንጀል፣ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር እና ሽብርተኝነትን ለመዋጋት ከአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ጋር ለመስራት ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም ምንም አይነት የተጠናቀቀ ዕቅድ እንደሌለና ማንኛውም የውጭ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የአገሪቱ ፓርላማ ይሁንታ እንደሚያስፈልገው አብራርተዋል። ይህ አቋም ፕሬዚዳንቷ በአገሪቱ እያደገ የመጣውን የፀጥታ ችግር በሌሎች የአካባቢው አገራት እንደሚታየው የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ሳይታወጅ ለመፍታት ያላቸውን ዝግጁነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kostaarikaa Laura Farnaandeez, yakka daangaa ce'uu, gurgurtaan mukhaalaa fi shororkeessummaa ittisuuf waraana Yuunaayitid Isteetsii wajjin hojjechuuf fedhii qaban ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hanga ammaatti karoori hojiitti hiikame akka hin jirre fi waraanni alaa kamiyyuu biyyattii keessatti socho'uuf hayyama mana maree biyyoolessaa akka barbaadu hubachiisaniiru. Dhimmi kun, pireezidaantittiin rakkoo nageenyaa biyyattii keessatti dabalaa jiru, akka biyyoota ollaa birootti labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa malee furuuf karoorfachuu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Betis beat Real Madrid as Mbappe misses penalty in first La Liga defeat
english: Real Betis handed Real Madrid their first La Liga defeat of the season with a 1-0 victory, ending Jose Mourinho's perfect start. Troy Parrott scored the decisive late goal for Betis, while goalkeeper Alvaro Valles secured the win by saving a stoppage-time penalty from Kylian Mbappe. Despite several attempts, Madrid were unable to break through the Betis defense, resulting in a surprising setback for the club.
amharic: ሪያል ቤቲስ ሪያል ማድሪድን 1 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ የዘንድሮውን የላሊጋ የውድድር ዘመን የመጀመሪያ ሽንፈት እንዲቀምስ አድርጓል። የጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ቡድን ከዚህ ቀደም የነበረውን አሸናፊነት ጉዞ የገታው የትሮይ ፓሮት ብቸኛ ግብ ነው። በጨዋታው መገባደጃ ላይ ኪሊያን ምባፔ የተሰጠውን የፍጹም ቅጣት ምት ግብ ጠባቂው አልቫሮ ቫሌስ በማዳኑ ሪያል ቤቲስ ድሉን ለማረጋገጥ ችሏል።
oromo: Ri'aal Betis tapha La Liga irratti Ri'aal Maadriid 1-0 injifachuun, jalqaba gaarii Jose Mourinho maasiif ture dhaabseera. Galchiin inni injifannoo Ri'aal Betisif argamsiise Troy Parrottin kan lakkoofsiisame yoo ta'u, goolkiin Alvaro Valles immoo yeroo dabalataatti kaasee goolii adabbii Kylian Mbappe dhaabuun injifannoo isaanii mirkaneesseera. Ri'aal Maadriid carraa hedduu qabaatus, ittisa Ri'aal Betis darbuu dadhabuun injifatamuu danda'eera.

title: US regulator opens safety investigation as Tesla launches driverless taxis
english: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has launched a formal investigation into Tesla's new autonomous Cybercab service. This probe aims to determine if the driverless vehicles comply with national safety regulations. The review follows the recent debut of the service in Austin, Texas.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀይዌይ ትራፊክ ደህንነት አስተዳደር በቴስላ አዲሱ የራስ ገዝ የሳይበርካብ አገልግሎት ላይ መደበኛ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ ምርመራ ያለ ሹፌር የሚንቀሳቀሱት ተሽከርካሪዎች የሀገሪቱን የደህንነት መስፈርቶች የሚያሟሉ መሆናቸውን ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። ጉዳዩ የተነሳው አገልግሎቱ በቴክሳስ ኦስቲን ከተማ በቅርቡ ከተጀመረ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Nageenyaa Karaa Gurguddaa Ameerikaa tajaajila konkolaataa ofiin oofuu kan Tesla 'Cybercab' jedhamu irratti qorannoo jalqabeera. Qorannoon kun konkolaatonni nama malee adeeman kunneen seera nageenyaa biyyattii kan guutan ta'uu isaanii mirkaneessuuf kan gaggeeffamu dha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe tajaajilli kun magaalaa Austin, Texas keessatti erga eegalamee booda.

title: Witkoff and Kushner will travel to ‘end’ Russia’s war in Ukraine: Trump
english: President Donald Trump has dispatched Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to Russia and Ukraine to attempt to restart peace negotiations. The envoys are expected to present a new peace proposal this weekend despite ongoing intense military conflict between the two nations. Trump believes personal animosity between the leaders of Russia and Ukraine has been a major obstacle to finding a diplomatic resolution.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል የተቋረጠውን የሰላም ድርድር እንደገና ለማስጀመር ጃሬድ ኩሽነርን እና ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍን ወደ ሁለቱ አገራት ልከዋል። ተወካዮቹ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ግጭት ቢኖርም፣ በዚህ ሳምንት መጨረሻ አዲስ የሰላም ሃሳብ እንደሚያቀርቡ ይጠበቃል። ትራምፕ በሁለቱ አገራት መሪዎች መካከል ያለው የግል ጥላቻ ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ዋና እንቅፋት ሆኖ መቆየቱን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaald Tiraamp, marii nagaa Ruusiyaafi Yuukreen gidduutti dhaabbate deebisanii jalqabsiisuuf Jaared Kushinerifi Istiiv Witkoof gara biyyoota lameenitti erganiiru. Bakka bu'oonni kun waraanni cimaan gidduu isaanii jiru iyyuu, dhuma torban kanaatti yaada nagaa haaraa dhiyeessuuf ni eegamu. Tiraamp, jibbi dhuunfaa hogganoota Ruusiyaafi Yuukreen gidduu jiru furmaata diippiloomaasii argachuurratti gufuu guddaa ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Death toll from Israeli attacks on Lebanon rises to three
english: Israeli military drone strikes in southern and eastern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of at least three individuals. The attacks targeted five distinct locations across the Tyre, Nabatieh, and Beqaa regions. Additionally, health officials reported that 23 people sustained injuries during these operations.
amharic: በደቡባዊ እና ምስራቃዊ ሊባኖስ በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የሀገሪቱ የጤና ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ በታይር፣ በናባቲዬህ እና በቤቃ ክልሎች በሚገኙ አምስት የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር። በዚሁ ጥቃት ተጨማሪ 23 ሰዎች የአካል ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el Kibba fi Baha Libaanoositti ergaa roga-malee (drone) fayyadamuun miidhaa geessiseen namoonni yoo xiqqaate saddeeti du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun naannolee Tyre, Nabatieh fi Beqaa keessatti bakkeewwan shanirratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoonni 23 immoo miidhaniiru.

title: Jewish groups back stronger measures on Israel in letter to Andy Burnham
english: Several Jewish civil society organizations have sent a letter to Prime Minister Andy Burnham demanding stricter policies against Israel and the protection of pro-Palestine protest rights. This push follows reports that the government is considering banning products from illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank. Meanwhile, some prominent British Jewish leaders and the Chief Rabbi are actively opposing these potential sanctions, arguing that such actions could harm the community.
amharic: በርካታ የአይሁድ ሲቪል ማህበረሰብ ቡድኖች በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ላይ ጫና በመፍጠር በእስራኤል ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስዱ እና የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ሰልፎችን እንዳይከለከሉ በደብዳቤ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ የተከሰተው መንግስት ከዌስት ባንክ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ የሚመጡ ምርቶችን ለመከልከል እያሰበ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ሆኖም አንዳንድ ዋና ዋና የአይሁድ ድርጅቶች እና ዋናው ረቢ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች በአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ይኖራቸዋል በሚል እርምጃዎቹን በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Gareewwan hawaasa Yihuudii hedduun, Ministira Muummee Andy Burnham biratti gidirsuudhaan Israa’el irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatuu fi mirga hiriira deggarsa Falasxiin kabajchiisuuf xalayaa barreessaniiru. Kun kan ta'e mootummaan Israa’el naannoo Qarxii dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti bakka buufata seeraan alaa irraa oomishaalee dhorkuuf qophiirra jiruun wal qabatee dha. Ta'us, hogganoonni Yihuudii biyyattii fi Rabbiin guddaan tarkaanfiin kun hawaasa Yihuudii irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisa jedhanii mormaa jiru.

title: Trump says Iran war is 'small potatoes' for US
english: Donald Trump has downplayed the ongoing military tension between the United States and Iran, labeling the conflict as minor. His administration is attempting to minimize the significance of these hostilities as the midterm elections approach. Trump reinforced this perspective by describing the situation as a limited military engagement rather than a major war.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለውን ወታደራዊ ግጭት አሳንሰው በመመልከት፣ ጉዳዩ ትልቅ እንደማይባል ገልጸዋል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከመካከለኛ ጊዜ ምርጫ በፊት የዚህን ግጭት ክብደት ለመቀነስ እየሞከረ ይገኛል። ትራምፕ ሁኔታውን እንደ ትልቅ ጦርነት ሳይሆን እንደ ተራ ወታደራዊ ግጭት በመቁጠር ጉዳዩን ከልክ በላይ እንዳይጋነን አድርገዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa kan Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti uumame baay'ee xiqqaadha jechuun xiqqeessanii ibsaniiru. Bulchiinsi isaanii filannoo dhufu dura dhimma kana akka waan cimaa tokkotti akka hin fudhatamneef carraaqqii gochaa jiru. Trump haala kana akka waraana guddaatti osoo hin taane, akka walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa kan salphaatti ilaalamu tokkotti ibsuuf yaalaniiru.

title: Why did Trump meet members of an anti-Zionist Orthodox Jewish group?
english: President Donald Trump recently hosted a delegation of Haredi Jewish leaders at the White House to mark the upcoming Rosh Hashanah holiday. The group included Rabbi Aaron Teitelbaum, a prominent figure known for his anti-Zionist views within the Satmar community. This meeting, which also involved Vice President JD Vance, drew attention due to the presence of these religious figures who typically oppose the existence of the Zionist state.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሮሽ ሃሻና በዓልን ምክንያት በማድረግ የሃሬዲ አይሁዳዊ መሪዎችን በዋይት ሀውስ ተቀብለው አነጋገሩ። በልዑካን ቡድኑ ውስጥ በሳትማር ማህበረሰብ ዘንድ የሚታወቁትና በፀረ-ጽዮናዊ አቋማቸው የሚታወቁት ረቢ አሮን ቴይቴልባም ይገኙበታል። ከምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ጋር በተካሄደው በዚህ ስብሰባ ላይ የተገኙት እነዚህ ሃይማኖታዊ መሪዎች፣ የጽዮናዊነትን ሀሳብ የሚቃወሙ በመሆናቸው በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doonald Tiraamp ayyaana Roosh Haashaanaa sababeeffachuun hoggantoota amantii Yihuudotaa kanneen 'Haredi' jedhaman Waayitii Haawusitti simatanii mari'achiisaniiru. Garee kana keessa, hawaasa Saatmaar keessatti kan beekaman fi yaada 'anti-Zionist' ykn mormitoota Ziwoonizimii kan ta'an Rabbi Aaron Teitelbaum argamu. Mariin kun fiixee hoggantoota amantii mootummaa Ziwoonizimii mormanii fi Muummicha Pireezidaantii J.D. Vaanis gidduutti taasifame kun xiyyeeffannoo hedduu argateera.

title: Israeli drones drop bombs on southern Lebanon’s Mansouri
english: Israeli military drones carried out an attack on the town of Mansouri in southern Lebanon. The operation involved dropping explosives, which resulted in multiple blasts across the area. This event is part of the ongoing hostilities occurring along the border region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ድሮኖች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በምትገኘው ማንሱሪ ከተማ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ድሮኖቹ ፈንጂዎችን በመጣል በስፍራው ተከታታይ ፍንዳታዎች እንዲከሰቱ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢ እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni malee namoota (drone) kan waraana Israa'el magaalaa Mansuurii kan kibba Libaanositti argamtu irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaanis boombiiwwan gadi darbamuun bakka sanaatti dhuka’iinsi hedduun dhaga’ameera. Tarkaanfiin kunis walitti bu’iinsa daangaa sana irratti taasifamaa jiru keessaa tokko dha.

title: Israeli strike kills two in southern Lebanon amid ongoing escalation
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a motorcycle in Kfar Reman killed two people as military operations intensify across southern Lebanon. Despite multiple U.S.-brokered truce agreements, Israeli forces continue to conduct heavy raids and artillery strikes against several towns in the region. These ongoing hostilities have resulted in significant casualties and widespread displacement since the latest escalation began earlier this year.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በከፋ ሬማን ከተማ በአንድ ሞተር ሳይክል ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል። በአሜሪካ አሸማጋይነት የተደረጉ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ቢኖሩም፣ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በበርካታ የክልሉ ከተሞች ላይ ድብደባ እና የአየር ጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። ይህ ቀውስ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና በርካታ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው መፈናቀላቸው ይታወቃል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Kfar Remanitti bakka kutaatti namoota lama ajjeeseera. Waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa mootummaan Ameerikaa giddu galeessummaan irra ga'e darbuun, Israa'el naannolee kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa ishee jabeessitee itti fufteetti. Kanneen keessa haleellaa kanaan namoonni hedduun du'anii, namoonni miliyoona tokkoo ol ta'an immoo manaa fi qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru.

title: Andrew Tate indicted in Romania for trafficking minors, money laundering
english: Romanian prosecutors have formally indicted influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan on serious charges including child trafficking, sexual exploitation, and money laundering. Authorities allege the brothers deceived victims into romantic relationships before forcing them to perform in sexually explicit online content through intimidation and violence. While the Tates maintain their innocence and plan to contest the claims, they are currently detained in the United States awaiting potential extradition to the UK for separate sexual assault allegations.
amharic: የሮማኒያ አቃቤ ህግ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪው አንድሪው ታይት እና ወንድሙ ትሪስታን ላይ ህጻናትን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ማዘዋወር፣ የፆታ ብዝበዛ እና ህገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ዝውውር ክስ መስርተዋል። ወንድማማቾቹ ሰለባዎቻቸውን በፍቅር ስሜት በማታለል በጉልበት እና በማስፈራራት በኢንተርኔት ላይ የብልግና ምስሎችን እንዲሰሩ ያስገደዷቸው እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ታይት እና ወንድሙ ክሱን በሙሉ ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ በእስር ላይ ሆነው ወደ ብሪታኒያ ለሚቀርብባቸው ሌላ የፆታ ጥቃት ክስ የውጭ ሀገር አሳልፎ የመስጠት ሂደትን በመጠባበቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Roomaaniyaa, beekamtii guddaa qabu kan jedhame Andrew Tate fi obboleessi isaa Tristan irratti yakka ijoollee gurgurachuu, gudeeddii fi qarshii seeraan alaa daddabarsuu jedhuun himata bananiiru. Obboloonni kunneen miidhamtoota jaalalaan gowwoomsuudhaan dirqisiisuu fi doorsisuudhaan marsariitii irratti viidiyoo qaama saalaa agarsiisu akka hojjetan dirqisiisaa turuu himatamaaniiru. Obboloonni Tate himata kana hunda kan haalan yoo ta'u, amma yeroof Yuunaayitid Isteetis keessatti hidhamanii, himata gudeeddii biroo biyya Biriteen keessatti irratti banamee jiruun gara biyyattii erguuf qophiirra jiru.

title: UN votes to adopt new world map that reflects Africa’s true size
english: The United Nations General Assembly has approved a new world map that correctly displays the true size of Africa, ending centuries of distortion caused by the outdated Mercator projection. Spearheaded by the African Union, this move seeks to correct the colonial-era bias that made Western nations appear larger than they actually are. While the new map is not legally binding, advocates hope it will lead to more accurate representations of the continent in schools, media, and digital platforms globally.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ የአፍሪካን ትክክለኛ መጠን የሚያሳይ አዲስ የዓለም ካርታን በይፋ አጽድቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የቆየውን የሜርካተር ካርታ አጠቃቀም በመቀየር ምዕራባውያን አገራትን ትልቅ አድርጎ የሚያሳየውን የቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን አድልዎ ለማስተካከል ያለመ ነው። ካርታው አስገዳጅ ባይሆንም፣ ትክክለኛውን የአህጉሪቱን ስፋት በትምህርት ቤቶች እና በሌሎች ሚዲያዎች ላይ እንዲንጸባረቅ ለማድረግ ትልቅ እርምጃ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Waltajjin Waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kaartaa addunyaa haaraa kan sadarkaa dhugaa Afrikaa sirriitti agarsiisu raggaasiseera. Murtoon kun kaartaa 'Mercator' kan durii fayyadamuurraan kan ka'e biyyoota dhihaa guddisee mul'isuufi jijjiirama yeroo kolonii irraa dhufe sirreessuuf yaadamee kan dhihaate dha. Kaartichi dirqama seeraa kan hin qabne ta'us, qabsoo kana gaggeessitoonni kaarticha manneen barnootaa fi miidiyaalee addunyaa irratti akka sirriitti fayyadaman abdii qabu.

title: Red Cross says four people released by Israel to Lebanon
english: The International Committee of the Red Cross helped return five Lebanese citizens home after they were released from Israeli custody. One person was sent back on Thursday, while the remaining four returned on Friday. This action follows reports that dozens of people have been held by Israel during the ongoing conflict with Hezbollah.
amharic: የቀይ መስቀል ዓለም አቀፍ ኮሚቴ በእስራኤል እስር ላይ የነበሩ አምስት የሊባኖስ ዜጎች ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ አድርጓል። አንድ ሰው ሐሙስ ቀን ሲለቀቅ የተቀሩት አራቱ ደግሞ አርብ ዕለት ወደ ቤታቸው ተመልሰዋል። ይህ የሆነው ከሂዝቦላህ ጋር በሚደረገው ጦርነት ምክንያት እስራኤል በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውላ በነበረችበት ወቅት ነው።

Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraana Hizboolaah wajjin jiru kanaan wal qabatee namoonni hedduun Israa'eelitti hidhamanii turuu hordofeeti.

title: Trump says US may hit Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain ‘soon’
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States might launch an attack on Iran's Pickaxe Mountain in the near future. This location is a highly secured underground facility situated close to the Natanz uranium enrichment site. The area contains complex tunnel systems that are protected deep beneath the earth.

oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Yunaayitid Isteets dhiyeenyatti biyya Iraan keessatti gara gaara ‘Piikaaks Maawuntiin’ jedhamutti haleellaa raawwachuu dandeessi. Iddeen kun bakka uraniyeemii qulqulleessan kan Naataanz jedhamu biratti argamu yoo ta'u, godoo ykn holqa gadi fageenyaan qotame kan of keessaa qabuufi eegumsa cimaa kan godhameef dha.

title: US Congress passes bill punishing universities that boycott Israel
english: The US House of Representatives has approved legislation targeting universities that boycott Israel or block student exchange programs with the country. Schools receiving federal funding will be required to confirm they do not limit academic cooperation involving Israeli institutions or students. Failure to comply with these rules could lead to penalties regarding their federal financial aid eligibility.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት እስራኤልን የሚያገዱ ወይም ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚደረጉ የተማሪዎች ልውውጥ መርሃ ግብሮችን የሚከለክሉ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎችን የሚቀጣ ህግ አጽድቋል። የፌደራል መንግስት ድጋፍ የሚያገኙ የትምህርት ተቋማት በእስራኤል የትምህርት ፕሮግራሞች ላይ ምንም አይነት እገዳ እንደሌለባቸው በየአመቱ ማረጋገጥ ይጠበቅባቸዋል። ህጉን የሚያከብሩ ከሆነም በተቋማቱ የፌደራል የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ላይ እርምጃ ሊወሰድ ይችላል።
oromo: Mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Ameerikaa, yuunivarsiitiiwwan Israa'el lagatan ykn sagantaa jijjiirraa barattootaa Israa'el waliin ta'u danqan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu danda'u dambiin tokko raggaasiseera. Yuunivarsiitiin gargaarsa mootummaa federaalaa argatan kamiyyuu, sagantaalee Israa'el keessatti ykn Israa'elota waliin ta'u irratti daangaa akka hin jirre waggaa waggaan mirkaneeffachuu qabu. Dambii kana kan hin kabajne taanaan, gargaarsa maallaqaa federaalaa irraa akka dhorkaman gochuu danda'a.

title: US Congress passes bill punishing universities that boycott Israel
english: The U.S. House of Representatives has approved a bill that threatens to cut federal funding to universities that boycott Israel or restrict exchange programs with the country. Supporters argue the move is necessary to stop discrimination against Israeli institutions, while critics claim it is a political tactic used to silence dissent regarding the war in Gaza. The legislation, which saw some bipartisan support, now awaits a decision in the Senate to determine if it will become law.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት እስራኤልን የሚያገዱ ወይም ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚደረጉ የትምህርት ልውውጦችን የሚከለክሉ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች የፌዴራል የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንዲቋረጥባቸው የሚያደርግ ሕግ አጽድቋል። የሕጉ ደጋፊዎች ይህ እርምጃ በእስራኤል ተቋማት ላይ የሚደረገውን መድልዎ ለመግታት አስፈላጊ ነው ሲሉ፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን በጋዛ ጦርነት ዙሪያ የሚነሱ ትችቶችን ለማፈን የተዘጋጀ የፖለቲካ መሣሪያ ነው ብለዋል። በሁለቱም ወገኖች የተወሰነ ድጋፍ ያገኘው ይህ ሕግ ተግባራዊ ለመሆን የሴኔቱን ውሳኔ እየጠበቀ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Ameerikaa kan Israa'eliin morman ykn jijjiirraa barnootaa Israa'el waliin ta'u dhorkatan yunivarsiitiiwwan irratti adabbii maallaqaa fi gargaarsa mootummaa dhabamsiisuu danda'u seeraan dabarseera. Deggertoonni seera kanaa tarkaanfiin kun gosa adda addaa irratti kan qiyyeefate (discrimination) dhaabuuf barbaachisaa dha jedhu; mormitoonni garuu seerni kun waraana Gaazaarratti yaada mormii dhageessisuu ukkaamsuuf kan oolu tarsiimoo siyaasaa ti jechuun morman. Seerni kun miseensota garee lamaanii irraas deggarsa kan argate yoo ta'u, amma gara seeneeti (Senate) ergameera.

title: Report: Israeli attacks kill eight Palestinians in past 24 hours
english: In the last 24 hours, Israeli military actions resulted in eight Palestinian deaths and dozens of injuries in Gaza. Health officials noted that rescue workers are currently unable to access many victims trapped under collapsed buildings or located in dangerous areas. Since the October 2025 ceasefire began, the total casualty count has reached over 1,300 deaths and 4,400 injuries.
amharic: ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ በእስራኤል ጥቃት ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። የጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር እና በአደገኛ ቦታዎች ያሉ ሰዎችን መድረስ ተስኗቸዋል። ከጥቅምት 2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ በደረሰው ጥቃት የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ1,300 በላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti, haleellaa Israa'el raawwateen lammiileen Palastinuu saddeet ajjeefamanii hedduun madaa'aniiru. Ministeerri fayyaa akka ibsetti, gargaartoonni balaa iddoo inni kufe fi bakka balaa jiru dhaqqabuu dadhabuun isaanii ibsameera. Labsii dhaabbii waraana Adoolessa 2025 kaasee, namoonni 1,300 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu fi 4,400 ol ta'an madaa'uun beekameera.

title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
english: Two survivors were recently pulled from a tunnel in Nepal more than a week after devastating flash floods caused widespread destruction. While the disaster has claimed over 1,300 lives, these rescues have provided a much-needed sense of optimism for families searching for missing loved ones. Rescue teams are continuing their efforts to locate others trapped in the tunnel network, despite the significant obstacles posed by debris and mud.
amharic: ኔፓል ውስጥ ከባድ ጎርፍ ከደረሰ ከሳምንት በላይ በኋላ ሁለት ሰዎች በዋሻ ውስጥ በሕይወት ተገኝተዋል። አደጋው ከ1,300 በላይ ሰዎችን ሕይወት ቢቀጥፍም፣ የነዚህ ሰዎች መዳን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ለጠፉት ወገኖቻቸው ተስፋ ሰንቀዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞች በጭቃ እና በድንጋይ በተሞላው ዋሻ ውስጥ የተቀሩትን ሰዎች ፍለጋቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Nepaaliitti lolaa cimaa erga ga'ee torbaan tokkoo ol booda, namoonni lama holqa keessatti lubbuun argamaniiru. Balaan kun lubbuu namoota 1,300 ol galaafatus, fayyinni namoota kanaa maatiiwwan warra hafan barbaadaa jiraniif abdii kenneera. Gareewwan fayyisituu haala qilleensaafi cilee ykn biyyee baay'een guutame keessatti namoota hafan barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
english: A Russian drone strike directly targeted the office of Ukraine's security chief within the SBU headquarters in Kyiv. President Zelensky confirmed the attack and ordered a retaliatory response as the incident caused damage to the building and injured several people nearby. This escalation highlights growing Russian drone precision ahead of anticipated international diplomatic discussions.
amharic: የሩሲያ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) በኪየቭ በሚገኘው የዩክሬን ደህንነት ቢሮ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ በደረሰው ጉዳት እና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች መኖራቸውን ተከትሎ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንዲሰጥ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በቅርቡ ለሚጠበቀው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ዋዜማ ላይ የሩሲያ ጥቃት እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።

Gochi kun marii dippiloomaasii gara fuulduraatti taasifamuuf deemu dura Raashiyaan haleellaa ishee hammaattee itti fufuun ishee mul'isa.

title: Indonesia wildfires send toxic haze across Southeast Asia
english: Widespread wildfires in Indonesia's Kalimantan province have destroyed over 200,000 hectares of land, causing severe ecological damage and endangering wildlife. The resulting toxic smoke has spread across Southeast Asia, leading to a significant decline in air quality for neighboring regions. Environmental organizations are now urging authorities to take responsibility for the crisis and address the environmental impact.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ካሊማንታን ግዛት እየተስፋፋ ያለው የእሳት አደጋ ከሁለት መቶ ሺህ ሄክታር በላይ መሬትን በማውደም በአካባቢው ለሚገኙ የዱር እንስሳት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ከእሳቱ የሚነሳው መርዛማ ጭስ ወደ ተለያዩ የደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ ሀገራት በመዛመቱ የአየር ብክለትን እያባባሰ ይገኛል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ቡድኖች ለዚህ ጥፋት ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር እና መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥበት ጥሪ እያቀረቡ ነው።

Gareeleen eegumsa naannoo balaa kanaaf itti gaafatamummaan akka fudhatamuufi tarkaanfiin hatattamaa akka fudhatamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Yemen’s army says recaptured key territory as clashes with Houthis continue
english: Yemeni government forces have reclaimed strategic hills in the Taiz region following intense two-day battles against Houthi rebels. The fighting, which spans the Red Sea coastline, has resulted in over 120 deaths on both sides, including government soldiers, rebels, and civilians caught in a ballistic missile strike. The Houthis are reportedly attempting to regain control of key areas overlooking the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and the port city of Mocha.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች ከሁቲ አማፂያን ጋር ላደረጉት የሁለት ቀን ከባድ ውጊያ ተከትሎ በታይዝ አካባቢ የሚገኙ ስልታዊ ኮረብታዎችን መልሰው መቆጣጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ በተካሄደው ግጭት በሁለቱም በኩል ከ120 በላይ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ፣ ከነዚህም መካከል ወታደሮች እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት የተጎዱ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ይገኙበታል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር ወሽመጥን እና የሞቻ ወደብን ለመቆጣጠር በማለም ጥቃቱን እንዳደረሱ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnooti mootummaa Yaman haleellaa guyyoota lamaaf Hutiifota wajjin taasisaniin booda, naannoo Ta'izitti iddoo tarsiimawaa ta'an deeffachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa qarqara galaana diimaa irratti gaggeeffame kanaan lubbuun namoota 120 ol darbeera; isaan keessaas waraana mootummaa, finxaaleyyii fi namoota nagaa haleellaa misa'eelaan miidhaman kan dabalatuudha. Hutiifonnni kunniin daandii galaana Baab al-Maandeebii fi buufata doonii Mochaa to'achuuf akka carraaqaa jiran gabaasameera.

title: Rescuers race to save 10-year-old Algerian boy trapped in deep well
english: Emergency teams in Algeria are currently working to rescue a ten-year-old boy named Ayoub who has been trapped in a deep well for two days. The child fell into the 80-meter-deep shaft located in the El Ghassoul region. Rescuers are acting quickly as they attempt to reach the boy and bring him to safety.
amharic: በአልጄሪያ ኤል ጋሱል በተባለ አካባቢ የ10 ዓመቱ ህጻን አዩብ በ80 ሜትር ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ በመውደቁ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች እሱን ለማውጣት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ህጻኑ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ከገባ ሁለት ቀናት ተቆጥረዋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኑ ህጻኑን በሰላም ለማውጣት ጊዜን በመሽቀዳደም ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Aljeeriyaatti mucaan waggaa 10 kan maqaan isaa Aayuub jedhamu boollaa gadi fageenya meetira 80 qabu keessatti kufuun guyyaa lamaaf achi keessatti qabamee jira. Gareen fayyistootaa mucicha lubbuun oolchuuf yeroo gabaabaa keessatti tattaaffii cimaa gochaa jiru. Tattaaffiin isa oolchuuf godhamu kun ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: US adds 162,000 jobs in August, raising Fed rate hike expectations
english: The United States added 162,000 jobs in August, significantly exceeding analyst expectations of roughly 55,000. Growth was largely driven by hiring in public education and the food service industry, while sectors like telecommunications and finance saw minor declines. This stronger-than-anticipated performance has prompted speculation that the Federal Reserve may increase interest rates at their upcoming meeting.
amharic: በነሐሴ ወር የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ከጠበቁት በላይ በሆነ ሁኔታ 162,000 አዳዲስ የስራ ዕድሎችን ፈጥሯል። ይህ እድገት በዋነኛነት በትምህርት ቤቶች እና በምግብ አገልግሎት ዘርፎች የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የቴክኖሎጂ እና የፋይናንስ ዘርፎች ግን መቀነስ አሳይተዋል። የተመዘገበው ጠንካራ የስራ እድገት የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ (ፌደራል ሪዘርቭ) በቅርቡ በሚያደርገው ስብሰባ የወለድ ምጣኔን ከፍ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ግምት አሳድሯል።
oromo: Ji'a Hagayyaa keessa, gabaan hojii Ameerikaa kutaalee barnootaa fi soorataa irratti hundaa'uun hojii haaraa 162,000 uumeera; kunis kan eegamee ture irra baay'ee caala. Hojiiwwan kun dabaluun isaanii, baankii giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Federal Reserve) dhimmicha irratti mari'atee qooda qabeenyaa (interest rate) dabaluu danda'a jedhamee akka yaadamu godheera. Guddinni kun dinagdee biyyattii keessatti cimina argisiiseera.

title: The number 10 shirt must not retire with Messi
english: Following Lionel Messi's retirement from the Argentine national team, there is a debate about whether the number 10 jersey should be retired in his honor. The article argues that the shirt should remain available for future generations of players to wear. Messi’s legendary career and accomplishments have cemented his legacy, but the jersey should represent the future of Argentine football rather than being locked away in the past.
amharic: ሊዮኔል ሜሲ ከብሔራዊ ቡድን ጡረታ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ፣ የሜሲን ቁጥር 10 ማሊያ ከጨዋታ ውጭ ይደረግ ወይስ አይደረግ የሚለው ክርክር ተነስቷል። ጽሑፉ የቁጥር 10 ማሊያ ለወደፊት የአርጀንቲና ተጫዋቾች ተደራሽ ሆኖ ሊቀጥል እንደሚገባ ይከራከራል። የሜሲ አስደናቂ የስፖርት ህይወት ለታሪክ የሚቀመጥ ቢሆንም፣ ማሊያዋ ግን ለወደፊት ተተኪዎች ተስፋ መሆን አለባት እንጂ መታገድ የለባትም።
oromo: Liioneel Meesi garee biyyaalessaa Arjantiinaa irraa erga soorama bahee booda, uffata lakkoofsa 10 kan inni uffatu ture akka itti hin fayyadamne gochuu qabana moo miti kan jedhu falmii kaasera. Barruun kun, uffanni lakkoofsa 10 kun dhaloota dhufuuf akka turuufi dorgommii gara fuulduraa irratti akka itti fayyadaman yaada dhiyeessa. Guddina Meesiifi milkaa'inni isaa seenaa keessatti kan yaadatamu yoo ta'u, uffanni kun garuu bakka seenaa qofaatti osoo hin taane, gara fuulduraa kubbaa miillaa Arjantiinaa kan bakka bu'u ta'uu qaba.

title: Israeli drone strike kills two in southern Lebanon
english: An Israeli drone attack in southern Lebanon's Nabatieh district resulted in the deaths of two individuals. Beyond this strike, Israeli forces also conducted military operations and explosions in several other nearby villages and towns. These incidents highlight the ongoing regional tensions affecting multiple locations within southern Lebanon.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ናባቲዬ አውራጃ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ከዚህ ጥቃት በተጨማሪ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ሌሎች መንደሮችና ከተሞች ላይም ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችንና ፍንዳታዎችን አካሂደዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የክልሉ ውጥረት አመላካች ናቸው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo Naabaatiyeetti miilaan haleellaa tirooniin raawwateen namoonni lama lubbuun darbaniiru. Haleellaa kana cinaatti, humni Israa'el baadiyaalee fi magaallan biroo naannichatti argamanirratti duula waraanaa fi dhukaasa gaggeessaniiru. Gochileen kun walitti bu'iinsi naannoo Kibba Libaanoositti dabalaa dhufe sun daangaa irra darbee bakkeewwan hedduu miidhaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Revealed: Microsoft signed $125m contract with Israel during first year of Gaza war
english: Microsoft secured a contract valued at over $125 million with the Israeli government throughout 2024. This agreement was identified within the official Israeli finance ministry budget records released in early 2025. Although the deal was not widely publicized, it was discovered after a detailed examination of government expenditure documents.
amharic: ማይክሮሶፍት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ከእስራኤል መንግስት ጋር ከ125 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚያወጣ ውል ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ስምምነት በ2025 መጀመሪያ ላይ በይፋ በወጣው የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር የበጀት ሪፖርት ውስጥ ተገኝቷል። ስምምነቱ ለህዝብ በስፋት ባይገለጽም፣ የመንግስት የወጪ ሰነዶችን በጥልቀት በመመርመር ታውቋል።
oromo: Maaykiroosoftii bara 2024 keessa mootummaa Israa'el waliin waligaltee doolaara miiliyoona 125 oliin tilmaamamu mallatteesseera. Waligalteen kun baajata mootummaa Israa'el kan bara 2025 keessa ba'e keessatti kan argame yoo ta'u, ragaan kun ibsa baajata mootummaa irratti qorannoo godhamee booda kan adda baafameedha.

title: Palestinian rights group condemns Israeli minister’s Gaza forced displacement remarks
english: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights has criticized Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz for proposing the forced relocation of Gazan residents by land, sea, and air. The organization argues that these plans, alongside Prime Minister Netanyahu’s territorial control claims, suggest an intentional strategy to change Gaza's population structure. They warned that such actions would be considered illegal under international law as a form of forced displacement.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የሰብአዊ መብቶች ማዕከል የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ ጋዛ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችን በጉልበት ለማፈናቀል ያቀረቡትን እቅድ አውግዟል። ድርጅቱ ይህ እቅድ እና ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የጋዛን መሬት መቆጣጠራቸው፣ የጋዛን የህዝብ ስብጥር ሆን ብሎ የመቀየር ሴራ እንደሆነ ገልጿል። እንደነዚህ ያሉ ድርጊቶች ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ እና በጉልበት ለማፈናቀል የሚደረጉ ህገ-ወጥ ሙከራዎች እንደሆኑም አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Wiirtuun Mirga Namoomaa Palastiin, Ministirri Ittisa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz jiraattota Gaaza bakka buqqaasuuf karoora baasuun isaanii balaaleffateera. Dhaabbatichi karoora kanaa fi ibsi Mummichi Ministeeraa Beenjaamin Neetaanyaahuu Gaaza to'achuu isaanii irratti kennan, fedhii uummata Gaaza jijjiiruuf yaadame jedheera. Gochi kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsuu fi nama dirqamaan buqqaasuu kan dabalatu ta'uu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Jewish groups back stronger measures on Israel in letter to Andy Burnham
english: A group of prominent Jewish figures and Holocaust survivors has sent a letter to UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, encouraging him to implement stricter policies against Israel. The signatories oppose the government's potential limitations on pro-Palestine demonstrations and argue that these marches are not inherently antisemitic. This move challenges other major Jewish organizations that have lobbied against the government's plans to sanction Israeli settlement goods.
amharic: የአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ መሪዎች እና የሆሎኮስት የተረፉ ቡድኖች ለብሪታኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ ቡርንሃም በጻፉት ደብዳቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ጠንከር ያለ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በፓለስቲና ደጋፊ ሰልፎች ላይ የሚጣሉ እገዳዎችን በመቃወም ሰልፎቹ ፀረ-ሴማዊ አይደሉም የሚል አቋም ይዘዋል። ይህ አቋም በእስራኤል ላይ የሚወሰዱ የንግድ ማዕቀቦችን በመቃወም ከሌሎች ዋና ዋና የአይሁድ ተቋማት የተለየ ነው።
oromo: Gareen miseensota hawaasa Yihuudii fi warri Holokoostii irraa ooran tokko, Muummicha Ministeera Biritishii Andy Burnhamif xalayaa barreessuun tarkaanfii cimaa Israa'el irratti akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Gareen kun hiriirawwan deeggarsa Paalastinii irratti daangaa kaa'uun sirrii akka hin taane fi hiriirawwan kun jibba Yihuudii kan babal'isan miti jechuun falman. Tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbilee Yihuudii guguddaa biroo kanneen daldala Israa'el irratti adabbii kaa'uun faayidaa hin qabu jedhanii morman irraa adda ta'eera.

title: Revealed: Microsoft signed $125m contract with Israel during first year of Gaza war
english: Microsoft has entered into a new $125 million software licensing agreement with the Israeli Ministry of Defence during the first year of the Gaza war. While the specific nature of the software remains undisclosed, the contract is scheduled to run until 2027. Experts suggest this deal may be a continuation of a prior multi-year partnership between the tech giant and the Israeli military.
amharic: ማይክሮሶፍት በጋዛ ጦርነት የመጀመሪያ ዓመት ውስጥ ከእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ጋር የ125 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሶፍትዌር ፈቃድ ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ምንም እንኳን የሶፍትዌሩ ዝርዝር ሁኔታ ይፋ ባይደረግም ስምምነቱ እስከ 2027 ድረስ የሚቆይ ነው። የዘርፉ ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት ይህ ስምምነት በቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያው እና በእስራኤል ጦር መካከል ቀደም ሲል የነበረው የረጅም ጊዜ ግንኙነት ቀጣይ ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Maayikroosoft waraana Gaazaatti waggaa jalqabaa keessa ministeera ittisa biyyaa Israa'el waliin walii galtee sooftiweerii kaffaltii 125 miiliyoona dolaaraa mallatteesseera. Haala sooftiweerichaa irratti odeeffannoon bal'aan kennamuu baatus, walii galtichi hanga bara 2027 tti akka turu ibsameera. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, walii galtichi kun hariiroo kanaan dura dhaabbata teeknooloojii kanaafi raayyaa ittisa biyyaa Israa'el gidduutti ture kan itti fufe ta'uu mala.

title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
english: The UK government has reaffirmed its commitment to the Falkland Islands following renewed sovereignty claims by Argentina’s President Javier Milei. President Milei stated he intends to impose sanctions on companies involved in local oil exploration, claiming the islands belong to Argentina. However, Downing Street emphasized that the UK will continue to protect the territory as long as its residents desire to remain a British overseas territory.
amharic: የአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዝዳንት ሀቪየር ሚሌይ በፎልክላንድ ደሴቶች ላይ የይገባኛል ጥያቄያቸውን ካነሱ በኋላ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ደሴቶቹን ለመጠበቅ ያላቸው አቋም ጸንቶ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ በደሴቶቹ አካባቢ የነዳጅ ማውጣት ስራ ላይ የተሰማሩ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ ገልጸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የብሪታንያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽህፈት ቤት የደሴቲቱ ነዋሪዎች የብሪታንያ ግዛት ሆነው ለመቀጠል እስፈለጉ ድረስ የብሪታንያ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንደማይለያቸው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Arjentiinaa Javier Milei naannoo Falklaandi irratti mirga abbummaa isaanii erga haaromsanii booda, mootummaan UK deeggarsa inni naannichaf qabu cimaa akka ta'e ibseera. Pirezidaantichi qorannoo boba'aa naannichatti geggeeffamu irratti hirmaatan irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatu dhaadateera. Ta'us, mootummaan UK jiraattonni Falklaandi biyya Ingiliiziin buluuf fedhii qaban hamma qabantetti, naannicha ittisuuf qophiidha jedheera.

title: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend, reports say
english: President Trump's peace representatives, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, are traveling to Moscow and Kyiv this weekend to discuss potential ways to end the ongoing war. They are scheduled to meet with President Vladimir Putin on Saturday and President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday. While these diplomatic efforts suggest progress, significant disagreements regarding territorial demands still stand in the way of a peace agreement.
amharic: የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የሰላም ልዑካን የሆኑት ጃሬድ ኩሽነር እና ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ፣ በዩክሬን እና በሩሲያ መካከል ያለውን ጦርነት ለመፍታት በሚደረገው ጥረት፣ ቅዳሜ በሞስኮ እና እሁድ በኪቭ ጉብኝት ያደርጋሉ። ልዑካኑ ከፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን እና ከፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጋር በመገናኘት ውይይት እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ተስፋ ሰጪ ቢሆኑም፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የክልል ይገባኛል ጥያቄ ለስምምነት ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ergamtoonni nageenyaa kan pirezidaant Traamp, Jaared Kushner fi Stiiv Witkof, waraana biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru dhaabsisuuf xiyyeeffannoon kan hojjetan yoo ta'u, torban kana gara Moskoo fi Kiyeef imaluuf jiru. Gareen kun Dilbata dura Moskootti Pirezidaant Vlaadimir Puutin wajjin, Dilbata immoo Kiyeefitti Pirezidaant Volodimiir Zelenski wajjin mari’atu jedhamee eegama. Sochiiwwan diippiloomaasii kun abdii kan kennan ta’us, gaaffiiwwan lafaa irratti walii galuun dhabamuun isaa furmaata nageenyaa irratti gufuu guddaa ta’ee itti fufeera.

title: Can the Green Party’s Polanski take on Labour and win Starmer’s old seat?
english: Green Party leader Zack Polanski is seeking to run for the Holborn and St Pancras parliamentary seat following the resignation of former Prime Minister Keir Starmer. While the Greens have gained significant local support in recent elections, political analysts view this as a difficult challenge because the constituency has been a reliable Labour stronghold for decades. Polanski’s success likely depends on national political shifts and whether Labour’s current popularity faces a decline before the upcoming by-election.
amharic: የአረንጓዴ ፓርቲ መሪ ዛክ ፖላንስኪ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኬር ስታርመር መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ በሆልቦርን እና ሴንት ፓንክራስ ለፓርላማ መቀመጫ ለመወዳደር እቅድ ይዘዋል። አረንጓዴ ፓርቲ በቅርብ ጊዜ በተካሄዱ ምርጫዎች በአካባቢው ተወዳጅነት ቢያገኝም፣ ይህ ወረዳ ለብዙ አሥርተ ዓመታት የሌበር ፓርቲ ምሽግ በመሆኑ ድሉን ከባድ እንደሚያደርገው የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች ይገልጻሉ። የፖላንስኪ ዕድል የሚወሰነው በአገሪቱ አጠቃላይ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ እና የሌበር ፓርቲ ተወዳጅነት በምርጫው ወቅት በሚኖረው ሁኔታ ላይ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan Paartii magariisaa Zaak Polaanskii, pirezidaantii duraanii Keer Staarmer iddoo isaanii gad-lakkisuu isaanii hordofee bakka bu'ummaa paarlaamaa Holboorn fi Sent Paankiras dorgomuuf murteeffataniiru. Paartiin magariisaa filannoo darbe keessa deggersa gahaa argatus, bakkeewwan kun waggoota dheeraaf kan paartii Leebarii waan ta'aniif mo'achuun rakkisaa akka ta'e ogeeyyiin siyaasaa dubbatu. Injifannoon Polaanskii kan hundaa'u jijjiirama siyaasa biyyattii fi filannoo guutuu dhufu dura beekamtiim ykn deggersii paartii Leebarii hir'achuu isaa irrattis ta'a.

title: Two Muslim women journalists allege police assault in India
english: Two female Muslim journalists have accused police officers in Delhi, India, of detaining and physically attacking them. In response, law enforcement officials have rejected these claims, stating that the women were only taken to the station due to a disagreement regarding vehicle parking. The situation remains a subject of dispute between the journalists and the local authorities.
amharic: ሁለት ሙስሊም ሴት ጋዜጠኞች በህንድ ዴሊ ከተማ በፖሊስ እንደተያዙና ድብደባ እንደተፈጸመባቸው ክስ አቅርበዋል። የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ መኪና በማቆም የተፈጠረ አለመግባባት እንጂ የተፈጸመ ጥቃት የለም በማለት ክሱን አስተባብለዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው የሃሳብ ልዩነት አሁንም በምርመራ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gaazexeessitoonni dubartoota Muslimaa lama ta'an tokko, magaalaa Deelii Hindii keessatti poolisiin qabamanii akka reebaman himatan. Qondaalonni poolisii gama isaaniitiin himannaa kana haaluun, dubartoonni kunneen kan qabaman walitti bu'iinsa bakka konkolaataa dhaabuu irratti uumameef qofa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun ammaaf gamoo lamaan gidduutti falmii keessa jira.

title: Philippine court orders arrest of VP Duterte over President Marcos threats
english: A Philippine court has issued an arrest warrant for Vice President Sara Duterte following accusations that she threatened to have President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family members assassinated. While the Vice President faces these criminal grave threat charges, she is also simultaneously undergoing an impeachment trial that could remove her from office. Legal representatives for Duterte stated she intends to follow the law, and she is expected to post bail to remain free while the proceedings continue.
amharic: የፊሊፒንስ ፍርድ ቤት ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ሳራ ዱቴርቴ በፕሬዝዳንት ፈርዲናንድ ማርኮስ እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ላይ የግድያ ዛቻ በመፈጸሟ የቁጥጥር ስር ማዘዣ አውጥቷል። ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንቷ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከባድ የዛቻ ክስ ከመጋፈታቸው በተጨማሪ ከስልጣን ሊያስወግዷቸው የሚችሉ የክስ ሂደት እየተካሄደባቸው ነው። የዱቴርቴ ጠበቆች እርምጃውን እንደሚከተሉ እና በዋስትና ለመለቀቅ ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii Filippiinsiitti, itti aantuun pirezidaantii biyyattii Saaraa Duteertee, pirezidaant Ferdinaandi Maarkoosii fi maatii isaanii ajjeesisuuf walii galte qabdi jedhamtee himatamteetti. Duteertee himannaa yakka kanaa fi adeemsa himannaa irraa kaafamuu ishee qaqqabsiisuu danda'u tokko tokko keessa jirti. Abukaatonni ishee akka jedhanitti, Duteerteen seera kabajuuf qophii ta'uu fi qabamuu ishee dura qarshii wabii kaffaltee akka gadhiifamtu eegama.

title: Ireland’s Katie Taylor eyes fairytale finish to trailblazing boxing career
english: Irish boxing legend Katie Taylor is preparing for the final fight of her historic career at Dublin's Croke Park this Saturday. The 40-year-old athlete will face undefeated challenger Flora Pili in a bid to secure a third undisputed world championship title in front of 80,000 home fans. Taylor, a pioneer who helped gain Olympic inclusion for women's boxing, intends to focus entirely on her performance despite the emotional significance of her retirement.
amharic: የአየርላንዷ የቦክስ ኮከብ ኬቲ ቴይለር ታሪካዊ የሙያ ጉዞዋን በደብሊን ክሮክ ፓርክ በዚህ ቅዳሜ በሚደረግ ፍልሚያ ለመቋጨት እየተዘጋጀች ነው። የ40 ዓመቷ አትሌት ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ አለም አቀፍ ሻምፒዮን ለመሆን ያልተሸነፈችውን ፈረንሳዊቷን ፍሎራ ፒሊን ትገጥማለች። የሴቶች ቦክስ በኦሊምፒክ እንዲካተት ትልቅ አስተዋፅዖ ያደረገችው ቴይለር፣ የጡረታ ጊዜዋ ስሜታዊ ቢሆንም ትኩረቷ በሙሉ በጨዋታው ላይ እንደሚሆን ተናግራለች።
oromo: Leenjistuun boksii beekamtuun biyya Ayirland, Keetii Teeylar, hojii ishee seena-qabeessa ta'e torban kana guyyaa Sanbataa magaalaa Dabliin keessatti xumuruuf qophii gochaa jirti. Atileetittiin umriin ishee 40 ta'e kun, yeroo sadaffaaf mo'ataa addunyaa ta'uuf morkattuu ishee kan taate Flora Piilii kan injifatamtee hin beekne waliin wal morkatti. Ispoortii boksii dubartootaa keessatti jijjiirama guddaa kan fidee fi carraa olompikii dubartootaaf banuu keessatti gahee qabdu kan taate Teeylar, xumura hojii ishee kanatti gammachuu guddaa keessa ta'us, xiyyeeffannoon ishee guutuu tapha irratti akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: Conflicts and extreme weather pushing global food prices higher, warns UN
english: The United Nations reports that global food prices have reached a four-year peak due to the combined impact of armed conflicts and severe weather patterns. Major supply routes and fertilizer shipments are being disrupted by geopolitical tensions, while heatwaves and climate phenomena are negatively affecting crop production. Experts warn that these increased wholesale costs will likely lead to higher grocery prices for consumers and could significantly worsen global hunger.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በጦርነት እና በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት የአለም የምግብ ዋጋ ላለፉት አራት አመታት ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን አስታውቋል። በጂኦፖለቲካዊ ግጭቶች ምክንያት የንግድ መስመሮች እና የማዳበሪያ አቅርቦቶች ሲስተጓጎሉ፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና የአየር ሁኔታ ለውጦች የምርት መቀነስ አስከትለዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በጅምላ ሽያጭ ዋጋ ላይ የሚታየው ጭማሪ ወደ ተጠቃሚው የገበያ ዋጋ እንደሚሸጋገር እና በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጦትን ሊያባብስ እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, walitti bu’iinsa waraanaa fi jijjiirama qilleensa hamaa hordofee gatiin nyaataa addunyaa sadarkaa waggoota afur keessatti hin argaminitti ol dabaluu beeksiseera. Walitti bu’iinsi siyaas-diinagdee dhiyeessii xaa’oo fi oomisha qonnaa gufachiisuun, hongee fi kutaannaan qilleensaa immoo oomishni akka hir’atu taasiseera. Gatiin nyaataa gurguddaa dabaluun kun gara fuulduraatti gatii suuqii irratti dhiibbaa uumuun namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman beela hamaaf saaxiluu danda’a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: 'Layer upon layer of miracles': How Nepal flood survivors were rescued from tunnel
english: A rescue team led by international experts and the Nepalese army successfully saved two men trapped inside a tunnel after catastrophic flash floods buried the entrance. Rescuers had to use old maps and satellite imagery to locate the buried opening and carefully employed explosives to clear massive debris without harming the survivors. The operation also required draining significant amounts of floodwater, which rescue leaders described as a miraculous effort given the extreme challenges.

title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage and Russia is the chief suspect
english: European nations are facing a growing wave of sabotage and arson attacks against defense facilities, which officials largely attribute to Russian involvement. Recent incidents include explosive drones discovered at a German airport and mysterious fires at military supply factories across several countries like Italy and Estonia. While Russia denies these accusations, European leaders are warning of an intensified strategy of hybrid warfare and urging increased vigilance.

title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
english: Diesel prices in the United States have reached record highs due to global supply disruptions caused by the ongoing war between the US-Israel and Iran. To address the resulting economic strain and public dissatisfaction, President Trump has established a new oil deal with Venezuela to increase domestic fuel supplies. Despite this initiative, some experts remain doubtful that the partnership will quickly resolve the rising costs impacting the transportation and agricultural sectors.

title: Reform UK officials step down as new funding scandal hits far-right party
english: Two high-ranking officials from Britain's Reform UK party have resigned following a documentary that accused them of violating election funding laws. The investigation alleged that the party sought to bypass rules by allowing an overseas company to pay for polling services. While party leader Nigel Farage denies any wrongdoing, both the police and rival political parties are now looking into the claims.

title: Argentina’s Milei threatens sanctions as he refocuses on Falklands
english: Argentine President Javier Milei has announced plans to implement strict sanctions against international companies involved in oil exploration near the Falkland Islands, which Argentina claims as its territory. By targeting firms like Rockhopper Exploration and their partners, Milei aims to assert Argentine sovereignty and strengthen his domestic political standing. While the UK government rejected these threats and reaffirmed its control over the islands, the move reflects a strategic effort by the Argentine leader to shift public focus toward national interests.

title: ‘Build The Wall’: White House arcade games face backlash
english: The White House is facing criticism for releasing a series of arcade games designed to promote Donald Trump’s political agenda. Critics are arguing that using public funds for these games is inappropriate. Furthermore, many have condemned the games for depicting migrants and people facing deportation in an offensive and dehumanizing manner.

Kana malees, taphoonni kun godaantotaa fi namoota biyyaa baafamaa jiran ibsuuf kan fayyadaman haala xiqqeessaa fi kabaja namummaa xureessuun akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Meloni sets a record, leading Italy’s longest-serving government since WWII
english: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has achieved a historic milestone by leading the longest-lasting consecutive government in Italy since the end of World War II. Her administration surpassed the previous record of 1,412 days, marking a significant departure from the country's usual history of political turnover. While supporters celebrate this durability as a major achievement, some political analysts caution that such longevity does not necessarily guarantee long-term stability.

Deeggartoonni isaanii milkaa'ina kana yoo kabajatan, ogeeyyonni siyaasaa tokko tokko garuu aangoo irra turuun qofaan tasgabbii siyaasaa fi bulchiinsa gaarii mirkaneessuuf gahaa miti jechuudhaan akeekkachiisu.

title: Israel takes its war on Palestine into the AI age
english: Israel is reportedly utilizing a sophisticated propaganda campaign that employs artificial intelligence to influence public perception of the conflict in Gaza. An investigation revealed that a fake think tank, funded by the Israeli government, generated vast amounts of content specifically designed to be ingested by search engines and AI chatbots. By creating automated, targeted reports, this operation aims to shape the information that AI systems provide to users worldwide.
amharic: እስራኤል በጋዛ ግጭት ላይ የህዝብ ግንዛቤን ለመቅረጽ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን በመጠቀም የተራቀቀ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ዘመቻ እያካሄደች መሆኑ ተገልጧል። ምርመራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት በእስራኤል መንግስት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚደረግለት የውሸት የምርምር ተቋም፣ በፍለጋ ሞተሮች እና በኤአይ ቻትቦቶች በቀላሉ እንዲዋጡ ታስበው የተዘጋጁ በርካታ ይዘቶችን አምርቷል። ይህ ድርጊት አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ለተጠቃሚዎች የሚሰጠውን መረጃ ለመቆጣጠር እና ተጽዕኖ ለማሳደር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el walitti bu'iinsa Gaazaa irratti ilaalcha uummataa jijjiiruuf teknooloojii aritifaal ispeeshil (AI) fayyadamuun duula oduu sobaa babal'isuu akka jirtu qorannoon tokko ifoomseera. Mootummaa Israa'eliin kan deeggaramu dhaabbanni qorannoo sobaa tokko, odeeffannoo sirnoota barbaacha intarneetii fi AI bira salphaatti gahuuf gargaaru hedduu akka uume ibsameera. Hojiin kun sirnoonni AI kun namootaaf odeeffannoo yeroo kennan akka fedha isaaniitti akka ta'uuf yaalii gochaa jiru dha.

title: UAE pardons Egyptian poet Abdul Rahman Yusuf al-Qaradawi
english: UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan has officially pardoned Egyptian poet Abdul Rahman Yusuf al-Qaradawi. Qaradawi had previously been sentenced to ten years in prison and fined for social media posts criticizing several regional governments. The activist was originally arrested in Lebanon and extradited to the UAE, where he faced legal proceedings following his controversial comments.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬትስ ፕሬዝዳንት ሞሐመድ ቢን ዛይድ አል ናህያን ግብፃዊውን ገጣሚ አብዱል ራህማን ዩሱፍ አል-ቀራዳዊ በይፋ ይቅርታ አድርገውላቸዋል። ቀራዳዊ ቀደም ሲል በተለያዩ የአካባቢው መንግስታት ላይ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በሰነዘሩት ትችት የአስር አመት እስራት እና የገንዘብ መቀጮ ተላልፎባቸው ነበር። አክቲቪስቱ መጀመሪያ በሊባኖስ ተይዘው ወደ ኤምሬትስ እንዲመለሱ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአስተያየታቸው ምክንያት በህግ ሂደት ውስጥ ነበሩ።
oromo: Pirezedantiin biyya UAE Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan, ganamseetiin biyya Masrii Abdul Rahman Yusuf al-Qaradawi dhiifama godhaniifiru. Qaradawi duraan namoota biyyoota naannichaa irratti qeeqaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti barreessaniif waggaa kudhaniin hidhamuufi adabbiin qarshii irratti muramee ture. Aktaivistichi jalqaba biyya Libaanoositti qabamee gara UAE ergame, achittis yaada isaa kanaaf seeraan gaafatamuu ture.

title: 'Secretive' UAE and Swiss-based firms found to be major crude suppliers to Israel, says report
english: A recent report by Oil Change International and SOMO reveals that two private oil trading firms, Vitol and Heritage Petroleum, have supplied over 22 million barrels of crude oil to Israel since October 2023. These shipments account for about 11 percent of Israel's total imports during this period and primarily pass through a Turkish port despite Turkey's official trade embargo. While officials claim shipments leaving Turkey are not destined for Israel, the report highlights how these companies utilize complex supply chains to facilitate deliveries.
amharic: በዘይት ለውጥ ኢንተርናሽናል እና በሶሞ የወጣ አዲስ ሪፖርት እንደሚያመለክተው ቪቶል እና ሄሪቴጅ ፔትሮሊየም የተባሉ ሁለት የግል የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ እስራኤልን በከፍተኛ መጠን በድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ሲያቀርቡ ቆይተዋል። ይህ አቅርቦት በእስራኤል የነዳጅ ፍላጎት ውስጥ 11 በመቶ ድርሻ ያለው ሲሆን፣ የቱርክ መንግስት ንግድ ማገዱ ቢኖርም ነዳጁ በቱርክ ወደቦች በኩል ያልፋል። የቱርክ ባለስልጣናት ከወደቦቻቸው የሚነሱ መርከቦች ወደ እስራኤል እንደማይሄዱ ቢገልጹም፣ ሪፖርቱ ኩባንያዎቹ አቅርቦቱን ለማድረስ ውስብስብ የንግድ ሰንሰለቶችን እንደሚጠቀሙ አጋልጧል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa 'Oil Change International' fi 'SOMO'tiin qophaa'e akka ibsutti, dhaabbileen daldala boba'aa Vitol fi Heritage Petroleum jedhaman, ji'a Onkololeessa 2023 irraa eegalee boba'aa dheedhii miliyoona 22 ol Israa'eliif dhiyeessaniiru. Dhiyeessiin kun raabsa boba'aa biyyattiin yeroo kana keessa galchite keessaa dhibbeentaa 11 kan haguugu yoo ta'u, Turkin daldala Israa'el waliin gootu dhorkitee osoo jirtuu boba'aan kun buufata Turkiin darba. Bulchiinsi Turkii markabooleen buufata isaanii irraa ka'an gara Israa'el akka hin deemne ibsanis, gabaasichi dhaabbileen kunneen karaa walxaxaa ta'een boba'aa sana Israa'el dhaqqabsiisaa akka jiran saaxileera.

title: UAE President pardons Egyptian poet Abdul Rahman Yusuf al-Qaradawi
english: UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan has granted a pardon to Egyptian-Turkish poet Abdul Rahman Yusuf al-Qaradawi. Qaradawi had previously been sentenced to ten years in prison for criticizing regional governments in a social media post. His case had drawn international attention after UN human rights experts raised concerns regarding his forced disappearance and the politically motivated nature of his extradition from Lebanon.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin UAE Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, walaloo barreessaa fi qeeqaa lammummaa Masrii fi Turkii qaban Abdul Rahman Yusuf al-Qaradawiif dhiifama godhaniiru. Qaradawin ergaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti mootummoota naannichaa qeeqeen booda, mana murtii Abu Dhabiin hidhaa waggaa kudhanii itti muramee ture. Gabaasni kun erga ifa bahee booda, ogeeyyonni mirga namoomaa kan UN, himannaa siyaasaa irratti hundaa'e fi hidhaa isaa ilaalchisee yaaddoo isaanii ibsuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Survivors recount US strike on wedding in Iran
english: A wedding celebration in the Iranian village of Kuhestak turned into a tragedy when a US military strike hit the area. While guests were gathered for the festivities, explosions damaged nearby infrastructure before a projectile directly struck the home where women and children were assembled. The event, which was intended to be a joyous occasion, resulted in a horrific ordeal for the bride, groom, and their families.
amharic: በኢራን ኩሄስታክ መንደር የነበረ የሠርግ በዓል በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ወደ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ተቀይሯል። እንግዶች በበዓሉ ላይ በተሰበሰቡበት ወቅት፣ በአካባቢው በደረሰ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ መሠረተ ልማቶች ከተመቱ በኋላ፣ ሴቶችና ህጻናት ባሉበት ቤት ላይ ጥቃቱ ደርሷል። ይህ በደስታ የታቀደው ቀን ለሙሽሮቹና ለቤተሰቦቻቸው እጅግ አሳዛኝ በሆነ ሁኔታ ተጠናቋል።
oromo: Ayyaanni cidhaa baadiyaa Kuhestak, Iran keessatti gaggeeffamaa ture erga rukuttaa waraana US irra ga'ee booda gara gaddaa hamaatti jijjiirame. Namoonni cidhaaf walitti qabamaniiru osoo jiranii, dhohiinsi dhaabbilee bu'uuraa gama biraa rukutee booda, bakka dubartoonniifi ijoolleen jiranitti dhukaasni cimaan qaqqabe. Guyyaan gammachuu ta'uu qabu kun hiriyoota gaa'elaa fi maatiisaaniif guyyaa gaddaa hamaa ta'eera.

title: Argentina threatens oil firms with sanctions as Falkland Islands dispute intensifies
english: Argentina has warned that oil companies drilling near the Falkland Islands could face legal penalties as the country increases pressure on the UK over its sovereignty claim. President Javier Milei claims the geopolitical climate is shifting in Argentina's favor, citing recent signals from Donald Trump that the US might reconsider its stance on the islands. Milei remains confident in Argentina's future while criticizing the UK's current national status.
amharic: አርጀንቲና በፎልክላንድ ደሴቶች አካባቢ የነዳጅ ቁፋሮ በሚያካሂዱ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስጠንቅቃለች። የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ፣ አሜሪካ በደሴቶቹ ላይ ያላትን አቋም እንደገና ልትገመግም እንደምትችል ዶናልድ ትራምፕ መግለጻቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የደሴቶቹ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ወደ አርጀንቲና እያደላ ነው ብለዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የብሪታንያ ተጽዕኖ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን በመጥቀስ፣ የአርጀንቲና ወደፊት ብሩህ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Arjantiinaan qorannoo boba'aa naannoo gubbaa Falklaandiitti gaggeeffamu ilaalchisee dhaabbilee irratti tarkaanfii seeraa akka fudhattu doorsisteetti. Pirezidaantiin biyyattii Javier Milei, Donald Traamp biyyi isaanii murtii ishee duraanii irratti yaada keessa akka galchitu ibsuu isaatiin, gaaffiin abbummaa Arjantiinaa milkaa'aa akka jiru himaniiru. Pirezidaantichi qarooma Biritishii gad aanaa akka jiru ibsuun, fuulduratti jijjiiramni gaariin biyya isaanii akka eeggatu dubbataniiru.

title: Nepal says it will need billions in funding to rebuild after flash floods
english: Nepal is facing a massive rebuilding challenge following devastating flash floods along its border with Tibet that claimed at least 1,200 lives. With thousands still missing and infrastructure destroyed, the government estimates it will require billions of dollars in international funding for recovery efforts. Despite the country's minimal contribution to global greenhouse gas emissions, it remains highly susceptible to the severe impacts of the climate crisis.
amharic: ኔፓል ከቲቤት ድንበር አቅራቢያ በተከሰተ ከባድ የጎርፍ አደጋ ቢያንስ 1,200 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ካጡ በኋላ ከፍተኛ የመልሶ ግንባታ ስራ እየተጋፈጠች ነው። በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንደደረሱ ባልታወቀበት እና መሠረተ ልማቶች በወደሙበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ መንግስት ለማገገሚያ ስራው በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር ዶላር እንደሚያስፈልገው አስታውቋል። ኔፓል ለአየር ንብረት ለውጥ መዛባት ያላትን አስተዋጽኦ እጅግ አነስተኛ ቢሆንም፣ የአየር ንብረት ቀውሱ እያስከተለ ባለው ጉዳት ግን ከፍተኛ ተጋላጭ ከሆኑ ሀገራት አንዷ ናት።
oromo: Neppaal daangaa ishee Tibetiin qabdu irratti lolaa hamaa mudateen lubbuun namoota 1,200 ol erga darbee booda, hojiin deebisanii ijaaruu guddaan ishee eeggata. Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman amma iyyuu bakka bu'an waan hin beekneef fi bu'uuraaleen misoomaa waan barbada'aniif, mootummaan deebisanii ijaaruuf qarshii biliyoonaan lakkaa'amu akka barbaadu ibseera. Neppaal gahee qilleensa lafaa manca'u keessatti qabdu baay'ee xiqqaa ta'us, miidhaa jijjiirama qilleensaa kanaan kan miidhamte biyyoota miidhaan irra ga'e keessaa ishee tokko dha.

title: Tensions flare as judge declines to remove juror in Lindsay Clancy trial
english: In the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children, the judge has ordered the jury to continue deliberations despite reaching a deadlock. Tensions rose in the courtroom when the defense requested the removal of a juror for allegedly failing to follow legal instructions regarding reasonable doubt. The judge denied this request, leaving the jury to resolve their internal conflict after over 35 hours of discussion.

In response, the UK government maintains that the islanders have the right to self-determination and remain committed to their status as British citizens.

title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
english: Bindi Irwin recently shared a heartfelt tribute to her father, the famous 'Crocodile Hunter' Steve Irwin, on the 20th anniversary of his tragic passing. While remembering him as a superhero, she reflected on how his dedication to conservation and love for the world continues to inspire her family today. Steve’s family, including his wife Terri and son Robert, continue to manage his legacy and Australia Zoo while keeping his memory alive for future generations.

title: No shelter or water, yet Lebanese return home, defying Israel.
english: Many Lebanese residents are choosing to move back to their villages in the south despite the extensive destruction caused by the Israeli military invasion. These returnees are facing a severe humanitarian crisis as they struggle to survive in damaged homes without access to clean water or proper shelter. The situation is increasingly urgent as the region prepares for the onset of winter.

title: Argentina’s Milei threatens sanctions over Falklands oil drilling
english: Argentine President Javier Milei has issued a warning of potential sanctions against oil companies that conduct drilling activities near the Falkland Islands. He remains firm on Argentina's sovereignty claims over the territory currently held by the United Kingdom. This diplomatic push comes amid his perception of shifting international dynamics and reduced American backing for British positions under the current U.S. leadership.

title: Arsenal sell Martinelli to Al-Hilal in post-transfer deadline day deal
english: Arsenal forward Gabriel Martinelli has completed a permanent move to the Saudi Pro League club Al-Hilal for a reported fee of 60 million pounds. This transfer sets a record as the highest exit fee in the history of the London club. The Brazilian international opted for this switch after being excluded from Arsenal's opening matchday squads by manager Mikel Arteta.

title: Mladic’s body arrives to full military honours in Serbia
english: The remains of Ratko Mladic, who was serving a life sentence for genocide and war crimes, have been transported to Belgrade. Upon arrival, he was given full military honors by Serbian authorities. Mladic had previously passed away in the Hague while imprisoned for his role in the Srebrenica massacre and the Sarajevo siege.

title: Entertainment over policy? White House arcade games ignite backlash
english: The White House has launched a series of arcade-style games on its official website to promote President Trump's policy agenda. This move has drawn significant criticism from politicians and activists who argue that the administration is trivializing serious issues like the high cost of living and international conflicts. Critics believe these games demonstrate a lack of empathy and seriousness, suggesting that the government should be focused on governance rather than entertainment.

title: Feminist trailblazer Gloria Steinem passes away at age 92
english: Renowned feminist activist and leader Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Since the late 1960s, she played a pivotal role in advancing the women's rights movement. Her lifelong commitment to equality served as a major inspiration for countless women across many generations.

title: Haitian government calls for renewal of international anti-gang task force
english: The Haitian government has requested that the UN Security Council extend the mission of an international security task force currently helping to combat violent gangs. Foreign Minister Raina Forbin emphasized the need for ongoing global support to restore stability before the country's planned elections in December. With gang violence causing significant loss of life and displacement, officials warn that security improvements are essential to ensure the electoral process can proceed safely.

title: Iran war live: US rules out Iran talks until ship attacks stop
english: The United States has stated it will not engage in negotiations with Iran until the country stops attacking commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz, with officials noting that all military options are being considered. Meanwhile, Iranian leadership claims its oil industry is successfully bypassing US sanctions despite ongoing difficulties. Tehran has also warned that any further US military action will be met with a complex and unconventional response.

title: Trump hints US would not back UK over Falkland Islands due to lack of Iran war support
english: Donald Trump has suggested he might not support the UK in a future conflict over the Falkland Islands against Argentina. He expressed frustration that the British government failed to provide military assistance during his efforts regarding Iran. This stance signals a potential shift in the historical US neutrality concerning the sovereignty of the territory.

title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
english: The US military is investigating reports from Iran that an American missile strike hit a wedding in the southern part of the country, resulting in at least five deaths. While Iranian officials have labeled the incident a war crime, US Vice President JD Vance expressed significant skepticism regarding these claims. The US maintains that its military operations target hostile forces rather than civilians, though authorities are looking into the situation.

title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
english: Doctors in the United States successfully transplanted a genetically modified pig kidney into a patient, which functioned for a record-breaking 271 days. This medical milestone highlights the potential of using animal organs to bridge the gap for patients awaiting human organ donations. While the kidney eventually stopped working, the procedure provided the patient with crucial extra time and hope while he waited for a suitable human donor.

title: Are Trump’s AI videos just memes or psychological warfare?
english: Donald Trump has recently increased his use of AI-generated imagery, including controversial videos depicting simulated military attacks on Iranian targets. While his team characterizes these posts as strategic communication, critics and observers are concerned about the ambiguity between political satire and real-world psychological manipulation. This trend creates uncertainty for international audiences who struggle to distinguish his actual policy intentions from digital propaganda.

title: Tunisia’s top court upholds conviction of opposition figures, activists
english: Tunisia's highest court has finalized prison sentences of up to 45 years for dozens of opposition leaders, lawyers, and activists accused of plotting to oust President Kais Saied. Critics and legal representatives argue the trial was politically motivated and lacked due process, serving as a symbol of the country's declining democratic standards. While the government maintains that the accused were threats to national stability, supporters of the opposition claim the judiciary is being used to silence dissent.

title: DR Congo joins countries pledging embassy move to Jerusalem
english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reaffirmed its intention to relocate its embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. This decision follows recent discussions between President Felix Tshisekedi and Israeli officials to strengthen diplomatic and economic cooperation. By taking this step, the DRC joins a small group of nations that have moved their diplomatic missions to the contested city.
