oromo: Riipaabiliikii Dimookiraatawaa Koongoon, embasii ishee Israa'el keessatti argamu magaalaa Tel Aviiv irraa gara Yerusaalemitti jijjiiruuf murtee dabarsite irra deebitee mirkaneessiteetti. Murteen kun kan dhufeyyuu Preezidaant Felix Tshisekedii fi hoogganoonni Israa'el hariiroo diippiloomaasii fi dinagdee cimsuuf marii erga taasisanii boodadha. Tarkaanfii kanaan, Koongoon biyyoota muraasa embasii isaanii gara magaalaa mormii irra jirtu kanaatti geeffatan keessatti dabalatamteetti.

title: Why are people calling Venezuela oil deal a new form of US colonialism?
english: Critics are labeling a major oil agreement between the United States and Venezuela as a modern form of colonialism. The deal grants the U.S. authority over a significant portion of Venezuela’s oil reserves for several decades. Furthermore, the agreement has sparked controversy because it was finalized without the necessary approval from the Venezuelan legislative body.
amharic: ተቺዎች በአሜሪካ እና በቬኔዙዌላ መካከል የተፈረመውን ትልቅ የነዳጅ ስምምነት እንደ አዲስ የቅኝ ግዛት ስልት እየገለጹት ነው። ስምምነቱ አሜሪካ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት የቬኔዙዌላን ከፍተኛ የነዳጅ ክምችት እንድትቆጣጠር ስልጣን ይሰጣታል። በተጨማሪም፣ ስምምነቱ የቬኔዙዌላ ህግ አውጪ አካል ይሁንታ ሳያገኝ መፈረሙ ከፍተኛ ትችትን አስከትሏል።
oromo: Mormitoonni walii galtee boba’aa Ameerikaa fi Veenezuweelaa gidduutti taasifame akka bifa haaraa koloniyaalizimii (gabrummaa) isaanitti ilaalu. Waliigalteen kun Ameerikaan qabeenya boba’aa Veenezuweelaa keessaa harka guddaa waggoota hedduuf akka to’attu carraa kennaaf. Kana malees, waliigalteen kun hayyama qaama seera baastuu biyyattii malee mirkanaa’uun isaa mormii guddaa kaasee jira.

title: Burnham, Macron talk border security and stronger Europe-UK ties
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron met in London to discuss strengthening UK-EU relations and tackling illegal migration. A key outcome of the talks was France’s commitment to deploy additional officers to its coast to help reduce small boat crossings in the English Channel. Both leaders also explored ways to boost economic cooperation, although Burnham remains cautious about fully aligning with EU market rules.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ከፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን ጋር ለንደን ውስጥ ተገናኝተው የሁለቱን ሀገራት ግንኙነት ማጠናከር እና ህገ-ወጥ የሰዎች ዝውውርን ስለመግታት ተወያይተዋል። በውይይቱ ወቅት ፈረንሳይ በባህር ዳርቻዎቿ ላይ ተጨማሪ የፀጥታ ሃይሎችን በማሰማራት የእንግሊዝ ቻናልን ተሻግረው የሚመጡ ትናንሽ ጀልባዎችን ለመቀነስ ቃል ገብታለች። መሪዎቹ የኢኮኖሚ ትብብርን ማሳደግ ላይ የመከሩ ሲሆን፣ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር በርንሃም ከአውሮፓ ህብረት የገበያ ህጎች ጋር ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመቀላቀል ይልቅ ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አካሄድ መርጠዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa UK Andy Burnham fi pirezidaantiin Faransaay Emmanuel Macron magaala Londonitti wal arguudhaan hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuu fi godaansa seeraan alaa to'achuu irratti mari'ataniiru. Marii kana keessatti Faransaay doonii xixiqqoodhaan qaxxaamuranii gara UK dhufan hir'isuuf jecha, bakka dooniin itti ka'anitti poolisoota dabalataa bobbaasuuf waadaa galteetti. Hoggantoonni kunneen haala dinagdee waliin cimsuu danda'an irratti kan mari'atan yoo ta'u, Burnham garuu gabaa Gamtaa Awurooppaa keessa galuu irratti ammayyuu of eeggannoo guddaa qaba.

title: Nepal flood victims to be identified through DNA
english: Severe flash floods in the Nepalese town of Timure near the Chinese border have resulted in many fatalities. Because the bodies recovered are severely decomposed or dismembered, authorities are unable to use traditional identification methods. Instead, forensic experts are utilizing DNA testing to help confirm the identities of the victims.
amharic: በቻይና ድንበር አቅራቢያ በምትገኘው የኔፓሏ ቲሙሬ ከተማ በደረሰ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ብዙ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። የተገኙት አስከሬኖች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጎዳታቸው እና በመበላሸታቸው የተነሳ በተለመደው መንገድ ለመለየት አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። በመሆኑም የፎረንሲክ ባለሙያዎች የተጎጂዎችን ማንነት ለማረጋገጥ የዲ ኤን ኤ ምርመራ እየተጠቀሙ ነው።
oromo: Godina Timure kan biyya Nepal, daangaa Chaayinaa biratti argamtu keessatti lolaa tasaa mudateen lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera. Reeffa argame irratti miidhaan cimaan waan gaheef, karaa idilee ta'een eenyummaa isaanii adda baasuun hin danda'amne. Kanaafuu, ogeeyyonni foorensikii eenyummaa namoota miidhamanii kana mirkaneeffachuuf qorannoo DNA fayyadamuutti jiru.

title: El Nino: A phenomenon supercharged by climate change
english: Scientists are concerned that the upcoming 2026-27 El Nino could be the most powerful ever recorded, fueled by the effects of global climate change. This weather pattern, which disrupts ocean currents and causes fish populations to migrate, is expected to intensify droughts, floods, and extreme heat worldwide. Experts warn that this event poses a severe threat to global food security, ecosystems, and the livelihoods of people who depend on agriculture and fishing.
amharic: የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት እ.ኤ.አ በ2026-27 የሚከሰተው ኤልኒኖ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጽዕኖ የተነሳ እስካሁን ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መልኩ ጠንካራ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ ክስተት የባህር ሞገዶችን በማዛባት እና የዓሳ ሀብትን በመበተን በመላው ዓለም ድርቅን፣ ጎርፍን እና ከፍተኛ ሙቀትን እንደሚያባብስ ይጠበቃል። ይህ ክስተት በአለም አቀፍ የምግብ ዋስትና፣ በተፈጥሮ ስነ-ምህዳር እና በግብርናና በአሳ ሀብት ላይ ጥገኛ በሆኑ ሰዎች ህይወት ላይ ከፍተኛ አደጋ እንደሚደቅን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Hayyoonni saayinsii akka jedhanitti, El Niinoon bara 2026-27 muudatu jijjiirama qilleensaa addunyaa irraan kan ka'e hanga ammaatti kan hin mul'anneen cimaa ta'uu danda'a. Sirni qilleensaa kun jijjiirama yaa'a galaanaaf sababa ta'uudhaan akkasumas hamma qurxummii xiqqeessuudhaan, guutuu addunyaatti hongee, lolaafi hoo'a cimaa akka hammaatuuf ni taasisa. Haalli kun nageenya nyaataa addunyaa, haala naannoo fi jireenya namoota qonnaa fi qurxummii irratti hirkatan irratti balaa cimaa akka qabu hayyoonni akeekkachiisu.

title: US Vice President JD Vance declines to offer timeline for end of Iran war
english: US Vice President JD Vance has refused to provide a specific end date for the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. During a press briefing, Vance downplayed the severity of the hostilities and suggested that the decision to stop targeting ships in the Strait of Hormuz rests entirely with Iran. He further argued that US military actions are effectively weakening Iran's defenses and stabilizing global energy markets despite the current disruptions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል እየተካሄደ ላለው ግጭት መቼ እንደሚያበቃ የተወሰነ ጊዜ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። በሰጡት ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ፣ ቫንስ የጦርነቱን ክብደት ለመቀነስ የሞከሩ ሲሆን፣ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ላይ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶችን የማቆም ውሳኔ ሙሉ በሙሉ በኢራን እጅ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የኢራንን የመከላከል አቅም እያዳከሙ እና የዓለም የኃይል ገበያን ለማረጋጋት እየረዱ መሆናቸውንም ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaan pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance walitti bu'iinsa Ameerikaa, Israa'el fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun yoom akka xumuramu guyyaa murtaa'e tokko kennuu irraa of qusataniiru. Ibsa miidiyaaleef kennaniin, Vance walitti bu'iinsi kun hammam akka cimaa ta'e xiqqeessanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, dooniiwwan galaana Hormuz irratti weerara gaggeeffamu dhaabuun murtoo Iraan qofa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Tarkaanfiin waraanaa Ameerikaa humna ittisa Iraan laaffisuu fi gabaa anniisaa addunyaa tasgabbeessuuf gumaacha akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: France records ‘hottest summer ever’ in 2026
english: France experienced its hottest summer on record in 2026, with average temperatures significantly higher than normal alongside severe heatwaves and drought. These extreme weather events, which included widespread wildfires and numerous excess deaths, highlight the growing impact of climate change across Europe. In response, the French government is working to fast-track new national strategies for climate adaptation and environmental protection.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በ2026 ዓ.ም ከተመዘገበ የሙቀት መጠን አንጻር በታሪኳ እጅግ ሞቃታማውን በጋ አሳልፋለች። የከፋ የሙቀት ማዕበል፣ ከፍተኛ ድርቅ እና የዱር እሳቶች በተከሰቱበት በዚህ ወቅት በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በአውሮፓ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጽዕኖ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ የፈረንሳይ መንግስትም ለችግሩ ፈጣን መፍትሄ ለመስጠት አዳዲስ እቅዶችን በመንደፍ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Faransaayi bara 2026 ganna baay'ee hoo'aa ta'e dabarsiteetti; kunis ho'a qaamaa seenaa keessatti galmaa'e isa olaanaa dha. Ganna kana keessa ho'i guddaan, hongeen akkasumas ibidda bosonaa babal'ate mudachuu isaa walqabatee namoota hedduutu du'e. Kuni jijjiirama qilleensaa guutuu Awurooppaa irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiru kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, mootummaan Faransaayis tarkaanfiiwwan hatattamaa qilleensa jijjiiramaa kanaan dura dhaabbachuuf karoorfataa jira.

title: Ipswich Town vs Liverpool: Premier League – prediction, team news, lineups
english: Liverpool manager Andoni Iraola is preparing for their upcoming Premier League match against Ipswich Town, where he hopes to secure his first win. The team recently signed French forward Bradley Barcola for 124 million pounds, making him their second-most expensive player ever. Barcola is expected to be available for the Friday fixture, joining a powerful attacking lineup despite his limited preseason play time.
amharic: የሊቨርፑሉ አሰልጣኝ አንድኒ ኢራኦላ በመጪው አርብ ከኢፕስዊች ታውን ጋር ለሚያደርጉት ጨዋታ የመጀመሪያ ድላቸውን ለማግኘት እየተዘጋጁ ነው። ሊቨርፑል ፈረንሳዊውን አጥቂ ብራድሊ ባርኮላን በ124 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ በማዘዋወር በታሪካቸው ሁለተኛው ውድ ተጫዋች አድርገውታል። ምንም እንኳን የቅድመ ውድድር ዝግጅት ሰዓት አግኝቶ ባያውቅም፣ ተጫዋቹ ለአርብ ጨዋታ ዝግጁ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Liverpool Andoni Iraola tapha torban dhufu Ipswich Town waliin taasisaniin injifannoo isaanii jalqabaa argachuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Liverpool weeraraa Faransaay Bradley Barcola paawundii miiliyoona 124n bituudhaan, taphattoota isaanii gatii guddaa baasanii bitan keessaa isa lammaffaa taasisaniiru. Barcola yeroo qophii tapha duraa gahaa argachuu baatus, tapha Jimaata kanaaf qophii akka ta'e fi garee weeraraa cimaa Liverpool keessatti akka hirmaatu irraa eegama.

title: 'Beautiful, vibrant' Disney star Carla Jeffery dies aged 33
english: Carla Jeffery, the talented actress recognized for her role as Bree in the Disney Zombies film franchise, has passed away at the age of 33. Her management team and colleagues have expressed deep sorrow, remembering her as a vibrant person whose positivity and bright smile left a lasting impact. Her twin brother and co-stars have shared heartfelt tributes honoring her memory and the joy she brought to those around her.
amharic: በዲስኒ የዞምቢስ ፊልሞች ላይ በብሪ ገጸ-ባህሪ የምትታወቀው ተወዳጇ ተዋናይት ካርላ ጄፍሪ በ33 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይታለች። የቀድሞ የሥራ ባልደረቦቿ እና አስተዳዳሪዎቿ እሷን እንደ ደማቅ ስብዕና እና ሁሌም ፈገግታ የተላበሰች ታታሪ ሰው አድርገው ያስታውሷታል። መንታ ወንድሟ እና ሌሎች የፊልም አጋሮቿም ስለ ህልፈቷ ያላቸውን ጥልቅ ሐዘን በመግለጽ ለቤተሰቦቿ መጽናናትን ተመኝተዋል።
oromo: Aartiin beekamtuu fi filmii Disney 'Zombies' keessatti gahee 'Bree' taphachuun beekamtuu kan turte Carla Jeffery umurii waggaa 33tti addunyaa kana irraa du'aan boqatteetti. Hojjettoonni ishii fi michoonni ishii, nama gammachuu qabduu fi ifa guddaa nama hunda biratti qabdu turte jechuun yaadatu. Obboleessi ishii fi hiriyyoonni ishii hojii ishii irraa gadda guddaa itti dhaga'ame ibsuun, maatii ishiitiif jajjabina hawwaniiru.

title: Is Nepal leading the battle for climate justice?
english: Nepal’s foreign minister is calling for the world’s largest polluters—China, the United States, and India—to pay for damages caused by recent flash floods. He argues that Nepal contributes very little to global carbon emissions and should not bear the financial burden for climate-related disasters caused by others. This stance highlights the growing push for climate justice, where wealthy, high-polluting nations are held accountable for the suffering of vulnerable countries.
amharic: የኔፓል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ከፍተኛ የካርቦን ልቀት የሚያደርሱት ቻይና፣ አሜሪካ እና ህንድ በቅርቡ በሀገሪቱ በደረሰው የጎርፍ አደጋ ለደረሰው ጉዳት ካሳ እንዲከፍሉ ጠይቀዋል። የኔፓል የካርቦን ልቀት ድርሻ እጅግ አነስተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ሀገሪቱ በሌሎች ሀገራት በተፈጠረ የአየር ንብረት ቀውስ እየተጎዳች መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ ሀብታም እና ከፍተኛ በካይ ሀገራት ለአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ተጠያቂ መሆን አለባቸው በሚል እየተነሳ ያለው የአየር ንብረት ፍትህ ጥያቄ አካል ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Neeppaal, biyyoonni qilleensa faaluudhaan beekamoo ta'an kanneen akka Chaayinaa, Ameerikaa fi Indiyaan, balaa lolaa dhiheenya kana isaan irra ga'eef kaffaltii beenyaa akka kaffalan gaafataniiru. Neeppaal gumaacha qilleensa faaluu keessatti hirmaannaa xiqqoo qabaattus, jijjiirama qilleensaa kanneen biroo uumaniin miidhamuu ishee ibsaniiru. Gaaffiin kun biyyoonni badhaadhonni fi faalamni qilleensaa irraa madde akka itti gaafatamaniif falmii haqaa qilleensaa irratti taasifamu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Four imprisoned Palestine Action activists appeal ‘terrorism’ sentences
english: Four activists from the group Palestine Action are challenging their legal convictions after being sentenced for damaging an Elbit Systems facility in the UK. Their case is historic because it represents the first time property destruction has been legally classified as an act of terrorism. The group is now seeking to overturn this significant and controversial judicial ruling.
amharic: የፍልስጤም አክሽን ቡድን አባላት የሆኑ አራት ተሟጋቾች በእንግሊዝ በሚገኝ የኤልቢት ሲስተምስ ፋብሪካ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል በሚል በተላለፈባቸው የእስር ውሳኔ ላይ ይግባኝ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጉዳይ የንብረት ውድመት በአሸባሪነት እንዲመደብ በብሪታንያ ፍርድ ቤት ሲወሰን የመጀመሪያው በመሆኑ አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። አክቲቪስቶቹ ይህንን አወዛጋቢ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ለመሻር ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hirmaattota garee 'Palestine Action' kan ta'an namootni afur, buufata dhaabbata Elbit Systems kan UK keessa jiru irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru jedhamanii hidhamuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Dhimmi kun seenaa keessatti yeroo jalqabaatiif yakka qabeenya mancaasuu akka 'shororkeessummaa'tti fudhatamee murteeffamuun isaa kan adda ta'e dha. Amma gareen kun murtii seeraa mormuun akka haqamuuf iyyata dhiheeffachaa jiru.

title: Foreign fighters and external support fuel Sudan’s war: UN-backed probe
english: A UN-backed investigation reveals that Sudan's ongoing civil war is being significantly prolonged by foreign military support and the recruitment of international fighters. Both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces are utilizing advanced drones supplied by outside entities, leading to devastating civilian casualties and potential war crimes. This external involvement has turned a domestic conflict into a worsening humanitarian catastrophe that threatens the lives of millions.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባደረገው ጥናት እንደታየው በሱዳን እየተካሄደ ያለው የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት በውጭ ሀይሎች ድጋፍ እና በውጭ ተዋጊዎች ተሳትፎ እየተባባሰ መጥቷል። ሁለቱም ተፋላሚ ወገኖች ከውጭ ባገኟቸው የላቁ ድሮኖች አማካኝነት ንጹሃን ዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሳቸው የጦር ወንጀል ሊያስጠይቁ የሚችሉ ጥሰቶች ተፈጽመዋል። ይህ የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነት ቀውሱን በማራዘም በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎችን ለከፋ ሰብአዊ ቀውስ ዳርጓል።
oromo: Qorannoon dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniin deggerame akka ibsetti, waraanni sivilii Sudaan keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru gargaarsa alaa fi loltoota biyya alaa irraa dhufaniin akka cimu ta'eera. Gareewwan lamaanuu meeshaalee teeknooloojii waraanaa fi diroonii alaa argataniin namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuun yakka waraanaa raawwachuu danda'u. Gargaarsi alaa kun rakkoo biyyattii kanaa dheeressuun, lammiilee miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman miidhaa namoomaa cimaaf saaxileera.

title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
english: Two Palestinian teenagers were killed during a confrontation involving Israeli settlers and military forces in the village of al-Mughayyir. Local officials claim the victims were trying to protect their livestock from settlers, while the Israeli military says they opened fire on violent instigators. This incident is part of a growing trend of violence in the West Bank, where residents face increasing threats and displacement efforts.
amharic: በአል-ሙጋይር መንደር በእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች እና በወታደሮች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ሁለት የፍልስጤም ታዳጊዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ታዳጊዎቹ ከብቶቻቸውን ለመከላከል ሲሞክሩ እንደተገደሉ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በበኩሉ አመፅ ቀስቃሾችን ለመቆጣጠር መተኮሱን አስታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት በምዕራብ ባንክ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ግጭት የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ፍልስጤማውያን የመፈናቀል ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል።
oromo: Godina waldhabdee jiru keessatti, dargaggoonni Falasxiin lama baadiyaa Al-Mughayyir jedhamtu keessatti du'aniiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa akka jedhutti, dargaggoonni kunneen horii isaanii saamamuu irraa ittisuuf yaalii gochaa turan; gareen waraana Israa'el garuu tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame walitti bu'iinsa uumame hordofee akka ta'e ibseera. Miidhaan kun biyya lafaa irratti naannoo sana keessatti rakkoon walitti bu'iinsaa fi dirqamaan buqqisuu dabalaa dhufuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Real Madrid’s Raul Asencio acquitted in sex-tape sharing case
english: Real Madrid defender Raul Asencio was acquitted of charges involving the non-consensual sharing of an explicit video after the victims chose to forgive the defendants. While the court dismissed his case, three other former youth players received suspended prison sentences for their roles in the incident. Separately, Asencio is facing disciplinary action from his club following a conviction for driving under the influence of alcohol.
amharic: የሪያል ማድሪዱ ተከላካይ ራውል አሴንሲዮ፣ የግል ምስልን ያለፈቃድ በማሰራጨት ክስ ከቀረበበት ጉዳይ ነፃ ሆኗል። ጉዳዩን የተመለከተው ፍርድ ቤት ተጎጂዎች ይቅርታ መጠየቃቸውን ተከትሎ ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ሶስት የቀድሞ የወጣት ቡድን ተጫዋቾች ግን በዚሁ ጉዳይ የእገዳ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። በሌላ በኩል አሴንሲዮ በአልኮል መጠጥ ተጽዕኖ ስር መኪና በማሽከርከር ጥፋተኛ በመባሉ ክለቡ ሪያል ማድሪድ በእሱ ላይ የዲሲፕሊን እርምጃ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Taphatni ittisaa garee Real Madrid Raul Asencio fiilmii saalaa hayyama malee qooduun himatamee ture seeraan bilisa ba'eera. Kun kan ta'e erga miidhamtoonni himatamtootaaf dhiifama godhanii booda yammuu ta'u, taphattoonni dargaggootaa sadan biroo garuu adabbii hidhaa yeroo qabanii akka turan murtaa'eera. Gama biraatiin, Asencio daandii irratti osoo machii jiru konkolaataa oofee argamuun isaa waan mirkanaa'eef, gareen isaa Real Madrid tarkaanfii angoo fudhachuu jalqabeera.

title: Houthi fighters clash with Yemeni government forces in country’s southwest
english: Houthi fighters have launched a significant offensive in Yemen's southwest, attempting to seize a critical supply road that connects Taiz to the port city of al-Makha. The conflict has resulted in dozens of casualties on both sides, with government forces reporting that they have managed to push back against the Houthi advances. This escalation raises concerns about a return to large-scale warfare in the region, particularly as the Houthis continue to target strategic areas near the Red Sea coast.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ደቡብ ምዕራብ ክፍል ወሳኝ የሆነውን የጣኢዝ እና የአል-ማካ ከተሞችን የሚያገናኝ መንገድ ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥቃት ከፍተዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል በተቀሰቀሰው ከባድ ውጊያ በሁለቱም በኩል በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የመንግስት ወታደሮች የሁቲዎችን ጥቃት ለመመከት መቻላቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ይህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ በየመን ውስጥ ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ ጦርነት የመመለስ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Finciltootni Huthis kibba-lixaa Yamanitti karaa magaala Taiz fi al-Makha wal-qunnamsiisu to’achuuf duula bal’aa bananiiru. Waraana cimaa kanaan garee lamaan irraas lubbuun namoota hedduu darbeera. Waraanni mootummaa haleellaa finciltootaa kana of irraa ittisuuf yaalii gochaa jiranis, tarkaanfiin kun Yamanitti waraanni bal’aan deebi’ee akka ka’u sodaachiseera.

title: Deadpool-Wolverine derby in the offing as Hugh Jackman targets Norwich City
english: Actor Hugh Jackman has expressed strong interest in purchasing a stake in the English football club Norwich City. This potential investment could lead to a friendly rivalry with his friend Ryan Reynolds, who successfully acquired and promoted Wrexham AFC. Both teams are currently competing in the Championship and hope to secure a spot in the Premier League this season.
amharic: ተዋናይ ሂው ጃክማን የእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ክለብ የሆነውን የኖርዊች ሲቲ የተወሰነ ድርሻ ለመግዛት ፍላጎት እንዳለው ገልጿል። ይህ ኢንቨስትመንት ከተፈጠረ፣ ወሬክስሃምን የገዛው ጓደኛው ራያን ሬይኖልድስ ጋር ተወዳዳሪ እንዲሆኑ ያደርጋቸዋል። ሁለቱም ክለቦች በአሁኑ ወቅት በሻምፒዮንሺፕ ሊግ የሚጫወቱ ሲሆን ወደ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ ለማደግ እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Aartistii Hugh Jackman kilabii kubbaa miilaa Ingiliiz kan ta'e Norwich City irratti qooda bituuf fedhii guddaa qabaachuu ibseera. Inni kun yoo milkaa'e, hiriyyaa isaa Ryan Reynolds kan kilabii Wrexham bituun beekamu waliin dorgommii tapha irratti akka waliin qabaatan taasisa. Gareewwan lamaanuu yeroo ammaa liigii Championship keessatti kan taphatan yoo ta'u, barana gara Premier League darbuuf abdii guddaa qabu.

title: 20 million children a year face online sexual abuse, UNICEF says
english: A recent UNICEF report indicates that approximately 20 million children across 21 countries face online sexual abuse or exploitation every year. Most of these incidents occur on social media platforms, yet very few cases are officially reported because children often feel afraid or unsure of how to seek help. This findings highlight a significant global crisis, as millions of youths are subjected to unwanted sexual content or the unauthorized sharing of their images.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የህጻናት መርጃ ድርጅት (ዩኒሴፍ) ይፋ ባደረገው አዲስ ዘገባ መሰረት በየዓመቱ በ21 ሀገራት የሚገኙ ወደ 20 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ህጻናት በኢንተርኔት አማካኝነት የጾታዊ ጥቃት ወይም ብዝበዛ ሰለባ እየሆኑ ነው። አብዛኛዎቹ እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረኮች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ቢሆንም፣ ህጻናት በፍርሃት ወይም እርዳታ ለማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው የተነሳ ጥቂት ጉዳዮች ብቻ ለባለስልጣናት ሪፖርት ይደረጋሉ። ይህ ጥናት በሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ታዳጊዎች በግዴለሽነት ለሚሰራጩ የብልግና ምስሎች ወይም ያለፍላጎታቸው በሚፈጸም የጾታ ግንኙነት ጥያቄ እንደሚጋለጡ ያሳያል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa UNICEF baase akka mul'isutti, biyyoota 21 keessatti waggaa waggaan ijoolleen miiliyoona 20 ta'an miidhaa fi saaxilamuu saal-qunnamtii interneetiin walqabatu mudachaa jiru. title: Billionaire Leon Black sues US congressional panel over Epstein subpoena
english: Billionaire Leon Black has filed a lawsuit against a US House committee to block subpoenas related to his past connections with Jeffrey Epstein. Black refused to attend a scheduled deposition, leading lawmakers to call for contempt of Congress charges against him. His legal team argues the investigation is an inappropriate overreach intended to damage his reputation rather than uncover facts.

oromo: Biliyeenarichi Leon Black qorannoo hariiroo isaa kan duraan Jeffrey Epstein wajjin ture ilaalchisee komitee Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummata Amerikaa irratti himata banateera. Black gaaffii fi deebii isaaf ramadame irratti dhihaachuu diduusaatiin, miseensonni komiteetichaa himata tuffii Mana Maree irratti akka banamu gaafataniiru. Gareen abukaattoota Black immoo, komiteetiin kun qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru dhugaa baasuuf osoo hin taane, maqaa isaa xureessuuf kan kaayyeffate akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
english: A powerful El Niño event is worsening drought conditions, leading to severe wildfires in Indonesia that have blanketed much of Southeast Asia in toxic smog. Millions of residents in countries like Malaysia, Singapore, and the Philippines are suffering from dangerous air quality levels, resulting in a surge of respiratory illnesses and other health complications. These recurring fires are largely attributed to long-standing environmental issues, including the clearing of forests and peatlands for industrial development.
